title.zh-TW: 系統提示詞支援即時重算，調校文案免重啟對話
title.en: Real-Time System Prompt Re-Rendering Without Restarting Conversations

body.zh-TW: 正在反覆微調提示詞（prompt）卻苦於每次改動都得開新對話，新的 `--system-prompt-snapshot off` 旗標正是為此而生。當你在打磨自訂提示詞內容時，系統預設會沿用工作階段初次錄製的提示詞快照，導致你在外側修改了檔案文字，當前的對話依然讀取舊版內容。現在只要在啟動 Claude 時帶上這個選項，每一次發出提問都會重新讀取並渲染最新的系統提示詞，讓文案調校的測試過程變得更加靈活迅速。⟦整套流程好似在排練室試穿戲服，每次出場都當場換上最新修改的布料剪裁，不必每修一針就得解散劇組重新開演。⟧
body.en: If you are iterating on prompt text and tired of starting a new conversation for every tweak, the new `--system-prompt-snapshot off` flag is built for you. When polishing custom prompt content, the system by default reuses the prompt snapshot recorded at session start, causing active conversations to keep reading stale content even after you edit external files. Now, by passing this flag when launching Claude, every request will reload and render the latest system prompt fresh, making prompt experimentation much faster and more flexible. ⟦The entire workflow is like trying on costumes in a rehearsal hall: actors step onto the stage wearing the latest fabric adjustments on the spot, rather than dismissing the entire cast to restart the show after every stitch.⟧

items.original: Added `--system-prompt-snapshot off` to render the system prompt fresh on every request instead of reusing the conversation's recorded prompt (for iterating on prompt text)

title.zh-TW: 外部工具異動保全推論思考，切換模型快取不漏接
title.en: Reasoning Preserved Across Tool Changes, Cache Reuse Holds on Model Switches

body.zh-TW: 當你請 Claude 呼叫外部工具或中途切換模型時，先前辛苦推導的思考脈絡不再無端消失。⟦這好比多位專家在會議室白板上記錄解題推導，中途就算外聘顧問進出或更換麥克風，也不會突然把整面黑板的心算擦掉重抄。⟧以往 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器重送模型已載入的工具、內建工具重繪，或工具因斷線升級而消失時，清單重寫往往會丟失先前的思考內容；如今推論皆能妥善保留。在未開啟工具搜尋的工作階段中，外掛動態加入也會改以延遲定義傳遞，避免破壞快取（把算過結果暫存起來直接用）複用。透過 `/model` 切換模型時不再重發全部工具定義；commit 與 PR 的歸屬文字改以對話附註送達，並會在切換模型時更新，且 claude.ai 連接器工具在工作階段更動時也能保住推論記憶。
body.en: When Claude invokes external tools or switches models mid-session, previously accumulated reasoning context no longer vanishes unexpectedly. ⟦This is like experts solving equations across a conference room whiteboard: even if guest consultants walk in and out or microphones get swapped, no one suddenly wipes the entire board clean to start over.⟧ Previously, when an MCP server re-sent definitions, a built-in tool re-rendered, or a tool disappeared due to disconnections or upgrades, rewriting the tool list discarded earlier thinking; reasoning is now safely preserved. In sessions without ToolSearch, dynamically added plugin tools are now passed as deferred definitions to prevent breaking prompt-cache reuse. Switching models via `/model` no longer re-sends every tool definition; commit and PR attribution text now arrives as a conversation note that updates on model changes, and reasoning memory is also retained when claude.ai connector tools change across session resumes.

items.original:
Fixed earlier reasoning being dropped when an MCP server re-sends, or a built-in tool re-renders, a tool the model already loaded
Fixed a tool that disappears mid-conversation, from a disconnected MCP server or an upgrade, rewriting the tool list and discarding earlier thinking
Fixed mid-session MCP and plugin tools being added to the tool list in sessions without ToolSearch, which broke prompt-cache reuse; supported models now receive them as deferred definitions
Fixed switching models with /model re-sending every tool definition (a prompt-cache miss); commit and PR attribution text now arrives as a conversation note that updates on model changes
Fixed prompt-cache misses and dropped extended thinking when a claude.ai connector's tools change between a session and its resume

title.zh-TW: 恢復工作階段沿用工具描述，背景任務不破壞提示快取
title.en: Resumed Sessions Reuse Tool Descriptions, Background Tasks Preserve Prompt Cache

body.zh-TW: 重新打開先前未完成的工作階段時，最怕背景暫存全部失效導致推論延遲。以前從對話分岔出的背景工作單元若把 `EnterWorktree` 這個工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）工具加進對話的工具清單，便會破壞快取重用機制。現在恢復工作階段時，不會再因 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）重連時間差而改寫工具清單或丟失思考，首回合執行工具時也能直接重播既有描述而非重新渲染。此外，從 `-p` 印出模式切換至互動模式時系統提示詞前綴保持一致。透過 `--system-prompt` 或 `--append-system-prompt` 啟動的子代理與工作階段，也會一次記錄提示詞與工具定義，不再每次重新渲染。⟦延續同一個會議記錄思維，這就像隔天回到會議室復工時，直接對照昨天蓋印封存的會議底稿接續討論，不會因為助手分頭跑腿或翻開備份記錄就擅自撕掉前言。⟧
body.en: When reopening unfinished sessions, cache invalidation causing inference delays is a major pain point. Previously, when a background worker forked from a conversation added `EnterWorktree` to the conversation's tool block, it broke prompt-cache reuse. Now when resuming a session, tool lists are no longer rewritten and thinking is no longer dropped due to MCP reconnection timing differences; turns executing tools on the first step also replay recorded descriptions directly instead of re-rendering them. Additionally, the system prompt prefix remains consistent when resuming a print-mode (`-p`) conversation interactively. Subagents and sessions launched with `--system-prompt` or `--append-system-prompt` now record prompt and tool definitions once instead of re-rendering them. ⟦Continuing the meeting records analogy, this is like resuming work in the conference room the next day with yesterday's stamped and sealed minutes, without tearing off the preface just because assistants ran errands or opened backup logs.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a background worker forked from a conversation adding EnterWorktree to the conversation's tool block mid-session, which broke prompt-cache reuse
Fixed resumed sessions rewriting the inline tool set when an MCP connector reconnects at a different moment than before
Fixed resumed sessions re-rendering tool descriptions instead of replaying the recorded ones when the first turn ran a tool
Fixed resumed sessions rewriting earlier MCP tool announcements (and dropping extended thinking) before their connectors reconnect
Fixed a prompt-cache break when a print-mode (`-p`) conversation is resumed interactively: the system prompt prefix no longer changes
Improved prompt-cache stability: subagents and sessions started with `--system-prompt` or `--append-system-prompt` now record the system prompt and tool definitions once instead of re-rendering them

title.zh-TW: 工件發布支援斷線自動重試，明確指出損壞字元行數與欄位
title.en: Artifact Publishing Adds Auto-Retry on Disconnects, Pinpoints Corrupted Character Locations

body.zh-TW: 發布工件（artifact，在獨立視窗展示的成果文件）若中途網路斷線或遇到格式錯誤，現在不再只回傳不明原因的失敗代碼。在過去，如果上傳檔案時連線中斷，Claude Code 往往只能回報未知結果；如今只要判定傳輸未完成，就會自動重試 1 次以確保順利送達。當頁面檔案並非有效的 UTF-8 編碼，或是包含代表損毀的替換字元（U+FFFD）時，錯誤訊息也不再模糊帶過，而是會具體標示出需要修正的行數與欄位。若工件發布遭到拒絕，畫面亦會清楚解釋被拒原因以及具體的應對處置方法。⟦這套防護有如印刷廠送件作業，遇到斷線能自動重發一次，內容包含損壞字元時會明確指出第幾行第幾列，被拒絕出版時也會清楚說明退件原因與修改方針。⟧
body.en: When publishing artifacts, network drops or formatting errors no longer return vague failure codes. Previously, if a connection was cut off mid-upload, Claude Code often reported an unknown outcome; now, whenever it detects that an upload never completed, it automatically retries once to ensure delivery. When a page file is not valid UTF-8 or contains replacement characters (U+FFFD) indicating corruption, error messages no longer gloss over the issue, instead explicitly naming the line and column to fix. If an artifact publish is refused, the screen also clearly explains the reason along with actionable remediation steps. ⟦This protection is like submitting print jobs to a press: it automatically retries once if transmission drops, pinpoints exact row and column numbers if corrupted characters appear, and provides clear rejection reasons and revision instructions if publishing is turned down.⟧

items.original:
Fixed artifact publishes cut off by a dropped connection mid-upload: they now retry once when Claude Code can tell the upload never completed, instead of reporting an unknown outcome
Fixed artifact publish failing with an unhelpful error when the page file isn't valid UTF-8 or contains a replacement character (U+FFFD); the error now names the line and column to fix
Improved Artifact tool publish errors: when a publish is refused, the message now says why and what to do about it

title.zh-TW: 遠端操控憑證過期自動續期，及時同步桌面與編輯器權限
title.en: Automatic Renewal for Expired Remote Control Credentials, Real-Time Desktop and Editor Permission Sync

body.zh-TW: 在遠端電腦透過 `claude remote-control` 連線工作時，長時間掛機最怕憑證失效讓所有連線瞬間中斷。⟦這如同在長效監控哨所配置專用通信機，遇到月度密碼過期會自行向總部換約重連而不斷線，新加入的聯絡終端也能即時掌握目前的防衛等級。⟧以往遠端伺服器憑證在大約 30 天過期後，主機行程會直接退出並切斷所有掛載的工作階段；現在主機端會自動重新註冊憑證並持續保持運作。同時，新加入 Claude Desktop 或 VS Code 工作階段的遠端操控客戶端，之前常停留在過期的舊權限模式直到手動變更，如今一連上就能立刻呈現即時且正確的權限狀態。
body.en: When working on a remote machine via `claude remote-control`, long-running sessions no longer suffer sudden drops from expired credentials. ⟦This is like equipping an outpost with a dedicated communicator that automatically renews its monthly passcode with headquarters without dropping the link, while newly connected terminals instantly reflect current defense levels.⟧ Previously, when server credentials expired after about 30 days, the host process exited and dropped all attached sessions; now the host automatically re-registers and keeps running. Meanwhile, Remote Control clients joining a Claude Desktop or VS Code session previously remained on stale permission modes until changed manually, but now immediately reflect accurate, up-to-date permission states upon connecting.

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control clients that join a Claude Desktop or VS Code session showing a stale permission mode until it was changed again
Fixed `claude remote-control` exiting and dropping every attached session when its server credential expires (about 30 days after start); the host now re-registers and keeps going

title.zh-TW: 企業受管設定嚴密把關，雲端憑證逾期精確回報
title.en: Strict Enterprise Managed Settings Enforcement, Accurate Cloud Credential Expiration Reporting

body.zh-TW: 在由公司統一控管規則的企業環境中，雲端排程與登入驗證具備更嚴密的防護。受管設定要求沙箱時 Cowork 雲端排程啟動失敗已修復；`allowedHttpHookUrls`、`httpHookAllowedEnvVars` 與 `allowedChannelPlugins` 讀取失敗時一律不予放行。在 Claude Desktop 下 AWS 或 Google Cloud 憑證過期不再盲目重試 10 次，改為提示重新認證；強制閘道登入框按 Esc 即可關閉。自建執行端會回報 `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` 並對使用舊代理的工作階段提出警示，轉發身分遇 429 限制不再轉移上游以落實每人配額。⟦整體防護宛若金融大樓的安全閘道，條文讀取不清時一律從嚴封鎖，身分過期不再盲目空轉十次，限制也確實落實到每位個別訪客頭上。⟧
body.en: In enterprise environments governed by centralized policies, cloud scheduling and login authentication now receive tighter safeguards. Startup failures for Cowork cloud scheduled tasks in organizations requiring sandboxing are now fixed; unreadable `allowedHttpHookUrls`, `httpHookAllowedEnvVars`, and `allowedChannelPlugins` settings now admit nothing rather than everything. Under Claude Desktop, expired AWS or Google Cloud credentials no longer blindly retry 10 times, prompting for re-authentication instead; pressing Esc now closes the mandatory gateway login dialog. Self-hosted runners now report `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` and warn sessions cloning via the legacy proxy, while `forward_user_identity` passes 429 rate limits directly to developers rather than failing over upstreams to enforce per-user quotas. ⟦The overall defense resembles security turnstiles in a financial building: unreadable rules strictly deny entry, expired badges no longer trigger ten pointless retry spins, and limits are enforced on every individual visitor.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Cowork scheduled tasks in the cloud failing at startup for organizations whose managed settings require sandboxing
Fixed expired AWS or Google Cloud credentials under a host app such as Claude Desktop retrying ten times with a generic "request failed" before the re-authenticate error appeared
Fixed managed `allowedHttpHookUrls`, `httpHookAllowedEnvVars` and `allowedChannelPlugins` to admit nothing, not everything, when unreadable
Fixed `/login` on machines whose managed settings require Claude apps gateway sign-in: Esc now closes the dialog instead of doing nothing
Self-hosted runner: Changed `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` to be reported to the server at registration and to print a warning for each session that still clones through the legacy git proxy
Gateway: Changed `forward_user_identity` upstreams to return a 429 as-is to a developer whose email was forwarded, instead of failing over to the next upstream, so the proxy's per-user limits hold

title.zh-TW: 終端機按鍵與滾動修復，輸入文字不再延遲跳格
title.en: Terminal Keystroke and Scrolling Fixes, Jitter-Free Responsive Text Input

body.zh-TW: 在手機或終端機全螢幕下操作各項指令，文字輸入與介面捲動現在更加乾淨俐落。⟦這恰似把老舊放映機的齒輪重新校準，打字輸入不再因為背景動畫轉動而延遲跳格，切換視窗或滑動閱覽時畫面資訊也穩定呈現。⟧以前在代理人檢視中重新連線至 tmux 或 ssh 工作階段後，Shift+Enter 換行與 Option+Backspace 刪除單詞等快捷鍵會失效，如今已完全修復。行動端設備執行 `/context` 等本機指令時輸出空白的問題已獲解決，在全螢幕向上滾動時，對話頂端也能正常顯示淡色的上一則提問提示。此外，`/diff` 程式碼差異面板不再先閃爍零個檔案變更與載入轉圈才定格，無改動時的空白提示也已置中對齊，打字時按鍵更不會被載入動畫卡住延遲。
body.en: Operating commands across mobile clients or fullscreen terminals is now much smoother for text input and interface scrolling. ⟦This is like recalibrating the gears of a classic projector: typing input no longer lags behind background animations, and screen details remain steady when switching windows or scrolling.⟧ Previously inside agent views, reconnecting to tmux or ssh sessions broke shortcuts like Shift+Enter for newlines and Option+Backspace for word deletion; these are now fully fixed. Blank outputs when running local commands like `/context` on mobile devices have been resolved, and scrolling up in fullscreen mode now reliably shows the dim last-prompt header at the top. Additionally, the `/diff` code difference panel no longer flashes "0 files changed" with a spinner before settling, its empty state is centered, and keystrokes are no longer delayed by loading animations.

items.original:
Fixed `/context` and other local command output rendering blank on mobile clients
Fixed shift+enter and option+backspace not working after reconnecting to a tmux or ssh session inside an agent view
Fixed the dim last-prompt header not appearing at the top of the conversation when scrolling up in fullscreen mode
Improved the `/diff` panel: it no longer flashes "0 files changed" and a spinner before settling, and its empty state is centered in the panel
Improved prompt input responsiveness: keystrokes no longer occasionally wait a frame behind spinner or streaming repaints

title.zh-TW: 恢復大容量歷史對話不掉內容，用量警示燈號穩定顯示
title.en: Restoring Large Conversation Transcripts Without Data Loss, Stable Usage Warnings

body.zh-TW: 恢復先前對話或載入超過 5 MB 的超大歷史紀錄時，整個還原過程變得更乾淨迅速。以前在包含大量 Bash 工具呼叫的對話中執行 `--resume`，首次渲染畫面常需等待；現在首次渲染更快。當工作階段的對話紀錄超過 5 MB 時，先前重新載入對話容易漏失平行工具呼叫與掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）輸出，如今資料都能完整重現。透過 `-p --resume` 執行 `/compact` 壓縮或其他斜線指令後，對話中也不會再多生出一筆多餘的接續提示。如果工作階段中因切換不同模型或模式而回傳不同的額度週期，用量上限警示也不會再忽明忽暗地閃爍。⟦整個載入流程好比翻開厚重的歷史卷宗，即使檔案超過 5 MB 且包含多條平行批註也能完整讀取，恢復作業時不再無故多插一張空白備忘頁。⟧
body.en: Resuming previous conversations and loading massive transcripts over 5 MB is now cleaner and faster. Previously, running `--resume` on sessions with many Bash tool calls caused noticeable delays on first render; first-render time is now shorter. When a session transcript exceeds 5 MB, reloading used to drop parallel tool calls and their hook output; all of it now comes back intact. Running `/compact` or other slash commands via `-p --resume` no longer inserts an extra spurious continuation prompt. If switching models or modes within a session returns varying quota windows, usage-limit warnings no longer flicker on and off. ⟦The entire loading process is like opening a heavy historical archive: even files exceeding 5 MB with parallel marginal notes load completely, without inserting an unneeded blank memo page upon resumption.⟧

items.original:
Fixed resuming a session after `/compact` or another slash command ran via `-p --resume`: a spurious "Continue from where you left off." turn is no longer inserted
Fixed resuming a large session (transcript over 5 MB): parallel tool calls and their hook output are no longer dropped from the reloaded conversation
Fixed the usage-limit warning flickering on and off during a session when requests for different models or modes report different limit windows
Improved `--resume` first-render time for sessions with many Bash tool calls

title.zh-TW: 終端指令回傳白話說明，市集路徑防護與沙箱複製指引
title.en: Plain-Language Terminal Command Descriptions, Marketplace Path Containment and Sandbox Copy Guidance

body.zh-TW: 讓 Claude 在自動模式或沙箱環境執行工作時，工具的引導說明與安全把關變得更親切嚴謹。以往執行終端命令時，Claude 常只是機械式複誦指令；現在更新了 Bash 工具說明指引，引導它用大白話解釋命令的作用。在沙箱內若遇到 `pbcopy` 等剪貼簿指令執行失敗，Claude 會主動建議改用內建的 `/copy` 指令。工作流程中帶有龐大輸出結構的 `agent()` 呼叫，在自動模式下不再直接被拒，而是交由安全分類器審查。在 macOS 與 Linux 上，外掛市集路徑帶有反斜線可繞過邊界檢查的漏洞已堵死；`claude agents` 的 `@` 選單也能即時列出工作階段開啟後新建立的儲存庫。⟦這如同給領航員換上更清晰的作業指南，執行指令時會用白話解釋步驟，遇到封閉環境複製失敗時也會主動推薦替代指令。⟧
body.en: When running Claude in auto mode or sandboxed environments, tool descriptions and security checks are now clearer and stricter. Previously when executing terminal commands, Claude often mechanically echoed the command; updated Bash tool guidance now steers it to explain what commands do in plain words. Inside the sandbox, if clipboard commands like `pbcopy` fail, Claude proactively suggests using the built-in `/copy` command. In workflows, `agent()` calls with large output schemas are no longer flatly refused in auto mode, routing to the safety classifier for review instead. On macOS and Linux, a case where a marketplace entry path containing a backslash could bypass the containment check has been closed, and the `claude agents` `@` menu now lists repositories created after session start. ⟦This is like giving a navigator clearer operational guidelines: explaining steps in plain terms when issuing commands, and recommending alternative commands when copy operations fail inside closed quarters.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Workflow `agent()` calls with large output schemas being refused in auto mode instead of being checked by the safety classifier
Fixed a case where a marketplace entry path containing a backslash could bypass the containment check for fetched marketplaces on macOS and Linux
Fixed `claude agents` `@` directory menu not listing repositories created after the session started
Improved the Bash tool's description guidance so Claude describes what a command does in plain words instead of echoing the command
Improved sandbox guidance so Claude suggests `/copy` when clipboard commands such as `pbcopy` fail inside the sandbox

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 差異檢視跟隨編輯器主題，修復截圖貼上與多語系文字
title.en: [VSCode] Diff View Adapts to Editor Themes, Fixes for Screenshot Pasting and Multilingual Text

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 裡與 Claude 對話，程式碼差異對照面板現在能完美貼合你的編輯器主題。⟦體驗改善有如為繪圖板換上具備自動調色的多功能畫布，不管是貼上圖片、選用高對比深淺外觀，或是處理帶有空格的檔名，筆觸都精準無誤。⟧過去對話框中的變更區塊總是強制以深色佈景顯示，現在會同步套用當前啟用的色彩主題與高對比模式。在 WSL2 或 WSLg 環境下貼上螢幕截圖時，不再把原始圖片位元組塞進輸入框，而是直接轉成附件或自動略過；同時修復了混合由右至左語系與英文時文字順序錯亂的問題。在檔案修改方面，採 Windows（CRLF）換行格式的檔案在確認套用變更時不再噴出找不到字串的錯誤，且使用 `@` 提及檔案時也不會漏掉路徑帶有空格的檔案。
body.en: When chatting with Claude in VS Code, code diff panels now align with your active editor theme. ⟦The upgrade is like outfitting a graphics tablet with an auto-adjusting color canvas: whether pasting images, choosing high-contrast dark or light themes, or handling filenames with spaces, every stroke remains precise.⟧ Previously, chat diff blocks always rendered with a dark theme; they now follow the active VS Code color theme, including high contrast. Pasting screenshots on WSL2 or WSLg no longer inserts raw bytes into the chat input, instead attaching the image or ignoring the paste if unavailable; typing mixed right-to-left and English text in the wrong order has also been fixed. For file edits, accepting changes in diff view on files with Windows (CRLF) line endings no longer fails with "String not found in file", and `@`-mentions no longer drop files with spaces in their paths.

[VSCode] Fixed pasting a screenshot on WSL2/WSLg inserting raw image bytes into the chat input; the image is now attached when the clipboard provides it, otherwise the paste is ignored
[VSCode] Fixed chat diff blocks always rendering with a dark editor theme; they now follow the active VS Code color theme, including high contrast
[VSCode] Fixed mixed right-to-left and English text rendering in the wrong order while typing in the message input
[VSCode] Fixed accepting an edit in the diff view on a file with Windows (CRLF) line endings failing with "String not found in file"
[VSCode] Fixed @-mentions dropping files whose paths contain spaces

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 遠端工作階段清單載入修復，排除循環歷史與行程空轉
title.en: [VSCode] Remote Session List Loading Fixes, Eliminating Cyclic Loops and Runaway Processes

body.zh-TW: 開啟含有大量捷徑或龐大專案的遠端主機時，VS Code 擴充套件不再因循環紀錄或檔案搜尋而把 CPU 衝上 100%。過去當對話存檔中包含循環的父層關聯時，進行對話分支、編輯歷史訊息或執行倒轉操作會導致外掛主機直接卡死在 100% CPU，現已修復。透過 Remote-SSH 連線且工作區資料夾僅存在於遠端電腦時，工作階段清單介面過去會載入失敗，目前已能正常顯示。此外，在超大型專案或含有密集符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）的工作環境中檢視檔案時，背景搜尋工具 ripgrep 行程失控狂飆的問題也獲得了解決。⟦承接同一個工作環境的平穩運作，這好似為巡檢機具加裝轉速調節器，遇到跨主機遠端連線或大量捷徑檔案時不再失控空轉。⟧
body.en: When connecting to remote hosts with symlink-heavy or massive codebases, the VS Code extension no longer spikes CPU to 100% over cyclic transcripts or file searches. Previously, when saved transcripts contained cyclic parent links, forking, editing earlier messages, or rewinding caused the extension host to hang at 100% CPU; this is now fixed. In windows connected over Remote-SSH where the workspace folder exists only on the remote host, the sessions list view previously failed to load and now renders properly. Additionally, runaway background ripgrep processes when viewing files in large or symlink-heavy workspaces have been resolved. ⟦Continuing the smooth operation of this workspace, this is like adding a speed governor to inspection machinery, preventing uncontrolled spinning during cross-host remote connections or encounters with heavy shortcuts.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the extension host hanging at 100% CPU when forking, editing an earlier message, or rewinding in a conversation whose saved transcript contains a cyclic parent link
[VSCode] Fixed the sessions list view failing to load in windows connected over Remote-SSH when the workspace folder exists only on the remote host
[VSCode] Fixed runaway ripgrep processes when viewing files in large or symlink-heavy workspaces

title.zh-TW: [Claude Code on the web] 企業版 GitHub 授權自動換新，調度本人帳號備援呼叫
title.en: [Claude Code on the web] Automatic Token Refresh for GitHub Enterprise, Personal Account Fallback for API Calls

body.zh-TW: 透過網頁版 Claude Code 操作 GitHub 企業伺服器時，逾期的 token（授權令牌，用於身分認證）現在會自動換新。⟦這宛如在雲端工作台配置全天候秘書，遇到通行權杖逾期會自動換發，即使所屬單位未安裝官方擴充套件，也能直接採用你本人的帳號順暢銜接。⟧先前在 GitHub Enterprise Server 的工作階段中，只要個人認證憑證到期，介面就會誤標為帳號已斷線；如今在進行拉取請求（PR）或討論議題操作時，系統會自動在背景刷新授權並保持連線。另外，在尚未安裝 Claude GitHub App 的組織架構下，執行 `gh` 命令或呼叫 API 原先會直接報錯，現在會直接改用你已綁定的 GitHub 帳號發送請求，若尚未登入也會明確提示。
body.en: When working with GitHub Enterprise Server via Claude Code on the web, expired tokens now refresh automatically. ⟦This is like assigning a 24/7 assistant to your cloud workbench: when access tokens expire, they are renewed automatically, and work carries on under your personal account even if the organization lacks the official app.⟧ Previously in GitHub Enterprise Server sessions, expired authentication credentials caused the interface to report the GitHub account as disconnected; PR and issue operations now automatically refresh tokens in the background to stay connected. Additionally, in organizations without the Claude GitHub App installed, running `gh` commands or making GitHub API calls previously threw errors, but now routes through your connected GitHub account and explicitly notes when none is connected.

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed GitHub Enterprise Server sessions showing your GitHub account as disconnected once its token expired; PR and issue operations now refresh it automatically
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed `gh` and GitHub API calls failing in organizations without the Claude GitHub App; they now use your connected GitHub account and say so when none is connected

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 預設連線支援切換自訂通道，額度耗盡清楚指引儲值

body.zh-TW: 負責管理 Claude Tag 團隊連線的管理者，現在不必刪除重來就能將預設通道切換至自訂連接器。在後台設定預設連線表單時，新加入的「Use a custom connector」連結允許你中途直接轉向自訂通道。當團隊組織的用量額度耗盡時，Claude 過去只會冰冷回報 API 拒絕了無效請求，現在會具體說明額度已用完並指引儲值方法。在頻道頂層發布訊息後，成員在討論串內要求編輯或刪除該則貼文時，指令不再被誤判為對話糾錯，而是確實轉交給當初發文的工作階段處理。此外，管理審查介面的工具存取授權請求點擊「Connect」時，之前常跳出授權失敗或誤報授權包已刪除的問題也已修正。⟦整個調整就像在團隊客服總機後台增加切換自訂外線的捷徑，額度用盡時明確告知儲值途徑，留言串內的修改請求也能準確遞交給當初發文的專員。⟧
body.en: Administrators managing Claude Tag team connections can now switch preset connections to custom connectors without starting over. When configuring preset connection forms in admin settings, a newly added "Use a custom connector" link lets you pivot directly to custom channels. When an organization runs out of usage credits, Claude previously replied with a generic message stating the API rejected an invalid request; it now explicitly explains credits are exhausted and details how to add more. After Claude posts a message at a channel's top level, thread requests to edit or delete that post are no longer treated as conversational corrections, routing properly to the session that originally posted it. Additionally, clicking **Connect** on Tool access requests under Admin settings > Review requests previously failed with "Authorization failed" or showed the access bundle as deleted; this has now been resolved. ⟦The overall update is like adding a shortcut to switch to custom outside lines in a team switchboard: clearly guiding top-ups when credit runs out and routing thread edit requests to the original dispatcher.⟧

[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude replying "The API rejected the request as invalid" when the organization has run out of usage credits; the reply now says so and explains how to add more
[Claude Tag] Fixed thread requests to edit or delete a message Claude posted at the channel's top level being answered with a correction instead of reaching the session that posted it

title.zh-TW: 自訂閘道連線修復，未公開變數不再誤擋請求
title.en: Custom gateway connection fixed, undocumented variable no longer falsely blocks requests

body.zh-TW:
如果你透過代理伺服器（替使用者轉發請求的中繼主機）連線 Claude，在 2.1.265 版可能遇到請求全部失敗。這是因為未記載的環境變數（開程式前預先設定的控制參數） `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY` 出現回歸異常。過去除非同時設定 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 與 `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`，否則它會被忽略；前一版卻單獨強制要求雲端閘道登入，導致搭配一般 API 金鑰、`apiKeyHelper` 或自訂標頭時每次請求都失敗。現在 2.1.266 版已修復，單獨存在時再次被忽略，你無須修改任何設定即可正常使用。

```
# 2.1.265 曾因單獨設定此未公開環境變數而強制要求雲端閘道登入：
export CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY=true

# 過去與現在：除非同時設定以下兩者，否則該變數會被忽略：
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://gateway.example.com"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="your-token"

# 搭配以下任一驗證時，前一版每次發出請求都會報錯：
# 1. API 金鑰（API key）
# 2. apiKeyHelper
# 3. 自訂驗證標頭（custom auth headers）
# 錯誤：Not signed in to the Cloud gateway
```

⟦這好比音響上的擴大機開關，原廠線材沒插齊時會自動忽略，前一版卻擅自鎖死專屬驗證導致放不出聲音，如今修復後恢復靜默。⟧
body.en:
If you connect to Claude through a proxy server, all your requests may have failed in version 2.1.265. This was caused by a regression with the undocumented environment variable `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY`. Previously, it was ignored unless both `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` were set; however, the previous version forced Cloud gateway sign-in on its own, causing every request to fail when paired with a standard API key, `apiKeyHelper`, or custom auth headers. Version 2.1.266 has now fixed this so the variable is ignored again when set alone, allowing normal use without changing any settings.

```
# In 2.1.265, setting this undocumented environment variable alone forced Cloud gateway sign-in:
export CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY=true

# Previously and now: the variable is ignored unless both of the following are set:
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://gateway.example.com"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="your-token"

# When paired with any of the following authentication methods, the previous version errored on every request:
# 1. API key
# 2. apiKeyHelper
# 3. Custom auth headers
# Error: Not signed in to the Cloud gateway
```

⟦This is like an amplifier switch on an audio system that is automatically ignored when original cables are not fully plugged in; the previous version arbitrarily locked into proprietary authentication and produced no sound, but now it returns to staying silent after the fix.⟧

items.original: Fixed a 2.1.265 regression affecting LLM-gateway and proxy setups: the undocumented `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_GATEWAY` environment variable, previously ignored unless `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` were both set, began forcing Cloud-gateway sign-in on its own in 2.1.265, so configurations that set it alongside an API key, `apiKeyHelper`, or custom auth headers failed every request with "Not signed in to the Cloud gateway". The variable on its own is ignored again; no configuration change is needed

title.zh-TW: 外掛目錄支援整批載入，執行中增刪子資料夾動態生效
title.en: Plugin Directory Supports Batch Loading with Dynamic Hot-Reloading for Subfolders

body.zh-TW: 如果你平常習慣自行開發多套擴充功能，過去每次啟動命令列時都得逐一指定外掛路徑。⟦這好比在展示架上加裝多格活動收納匣，只要把裝有說明清單的小抽屜放進去就會自動啟用，中途抽換或添補也不必拆開展示架。⟧現在 `--plugin-dir` 參數直接支援指向包含多個外掛的父資料夾。只要其下的每個子資料夾具備清單檔案（記錄外掛名稱與規格的說明文件），系統啟動時就會自動識別並載入全部擴充套件。更方便的是，在程式執行運作途中，若你在該目錄下新增或移除子資料夾，變更都會被即時動態偵測並直接生效，省下反覆重開對話的麻煩。
body.en: If you regularly develop multiple extensions, you previously had to specify each plugin path individually whenever starting the command line. ⟦This is like adding a multi-slot modular organizer to a display rack, where slotting in small drawers with manifest cards automatically enables them, and swapping or adding drawers midway requires no disassembly of the rack.⟧ Now, the `--plugin-dir` flag directly supports pointing to a parent folder containing multiple plugins. As long as each child folder inside has a manifest file (a specification document recording plugin metadata), the system automatically discovers and loads all extensions on startup. Even better, adding or removing child folders under that directory while running is dynamically detected and applied immediately, saving you from repeatedly restarting sessions.

items.original: Added support for pointing `--plugin-dir` at a folder of plugins: each child folder with a manifest loads, and children added or removed while running are picked up

title.zh-TW: 外掛路徑檢查防護補強，市集資訊與安裝清單更完整
title.en: Plugin Path Containment Checks Hardened with More Complete Marketplace Details and Lists

body.zh-TW: 管理外掛時的安全驗證與市集清單呈現，在這版獲得全面修正。在 macOS 與 Linux 上，路徑含有反斜線的外掛不再繞過符號連結（指向目標路徑的捷徑檔案）安全檢查。名稱開頭為雙點號的資料夾，也不會再被誤判為超出外掛根目錄。若遇到作業系統無法檢查的元件目錄（例如符號連結無限循環），過去會被默默略過，現在會於 `/plugin` 明確回報錯誤碼。在資訊顯示方面，若外掛中繼資料只寫在 `plugin.json`，市集探索清單與 `claude plugin list --json --available` 會完整顯示描述與名稱；已安裝分頁和 `claude plugin details` 則優先採用市集登記資訊，並以檔案補齊缺漏欄位。⟦整體審查好比商業大樓嚴格查驗各進駐商家的登記捷徑與門牌，並將專櫃招牌統整更新，缺漏資訊也能自動對照底冊補齊。⟧
body.en: Security validation and marketplace listing displays when managing plugins have received comprehensive fixes in this release. On macOS and Linux, plugins with paths containing backslashes no longer bypass symlink containment checks. Folders whose names start with two dots are no longer mistakenly refused as outside the plugin root. If the OS cannot check a component folder (such as a symlink loop), it is now explicitly reported with an error code in `/plugin` instead of being silently skipped. Regarding information display, marketplace discovery listings and `claude plugin list --json --available` now fully display descriptions and names for plugins whose metadata lives only in `plugin.json`. Meanwhile, the Installed tab and `claude plugin details` prioritize marketplace registry entries, filling any missing fields from `plugin.json`. ⟦The entire audit is like a commercial building strictly vetting registration shortcuts and unit numbers for every merchant while updating tenant signage and automatically filling in missing directory details against master records.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a plugin path containing a backslash bypassing the symlink containment check on macOS and Linux
Fixed plugin directories whose names begin with two dots being wrongly refused as outside the plugin root
Fixed a plugin's default component folder that the OS cannot check, such as a symlink loop, being silently skipped; it is now reported in `/plugin` with the error code
Fixed `/plugin` Discover/Browse and `claude plugin list --json --available` showing no description or display name for marketplace plugins whose metadata lives only in their `plugin.json`
Changed plugin display metadata to prefer the marketplace entry over `plugin.json` on the Installed tab and `claude plugin details`, filling gaps from `plugin.json`

title.zh-TW: 子代理提示前綴維持固定，快取命中率提升且工具中斷不重寫
title.en: Subagent Prompt Prefixes Locked for Higher Cache Reuse and Interrupted Tool Calls Preserved

body.zh-TW: 多代理人協作與接續執行工作時，提示詞的快取機制現在更加可靠。⟦這如同研究員交接時維持相同開場索引，前言與工具清單固定不動便能重複查閱現有筆記，遇到意外停電也會在未完成的紀錄旁夾上中斷書籤。⟧先前恢復前景生成的子代理人時，工具清單與系統提示詞前綴常會變動，導致快取（把算過的資料暫存起來供後續直接取用）無法重用。隊友代理人與恢復後的子代理人，也會在後續回合將 `SubagentStart` 掛鉤（特定事件觸發時執行的自動程式）與預載技能移出前綴，同樣破壞快取效益。現在這些前綴結構已全數鎖定固定位置。此外，若前次行程在工具執行途中無預警終止，恢復時不再重寫最後一道提示詞，而是完整保留該次工具呼叫並標記為中斷。
body.en: Prompt caching mechanisms are now far more reliable during multi-agent collaboration and resumed workflows. ⟦This is like researchers maintaining an identical index upon handover, keeping the preamble and tool catalog fixed so existing notes can be reused while bookmarking interrupted entries during an unexpected outage.⟧ Previously, resuming a foreground-spawned subagent would alter its tool list and system prompt prefix, breaking prompt-cache reuse. Agent teammates and resumed subagents also moved `SubagentStart` hook context and preloaded skills out of the prompt prefix on later turns, similarly destroying cache benefits. Now, all these prefix structures remain locked in place. In addition, if a previous process died unexpectedly while a tool was running, resuming no longer rewrites the final prompt, but instead fully retains the tool call and marks it as interrupted.

items.original:
Fixed resuming a foreground-spawned subagent changing its tool list and system prompt prefix, which broke prompt-cache reuse for that agent
Fixed agent teammates and resumed subagents moving SubagentStart hook context and preloaded skills out of the prompt prefix on later turns, which broke prompt-cache reuse
Fixed resume after the previous process died while a tool was running: the last prompt is no longer rewritten, and the interrupted tool call is kept and marked interrupted

title.zh-TW: 工作流面板支援展開呼叫細節，分支技能串流與容器復原更明確
title.en: Workflows Panel Unfolds Tool Calls with Clearer Forked Skill Streaming and Container Recovery

body.zh-TW: 執行多步驟的工作流與分支技能時，進度追蹤與異常診斷變得清楚直接。在 `/workflows` 代理人詳細資訊面板中，各項工具呼叫現在會清晰標記為執行中、失敗或已完成，若子代理人附帶工作清單也會同步呈現，按下 Enter 鍵還能直接展開查看呼叫參數與執行結果。當使用分支技能（以 `context: fork` 在獨立背景分支執行的技能）時，其起始提示詞，以及搭配 `--forward-subagent-text` 產生的對話回合，現在都會以進度事件正確串流至 `stream-json` 輸出。如果工作流容器重啟且執行日誌遺失，系統會直接回報明確錯誤訊息，不再盲目重跑每一個代理人。⟦整個過程宛如在現代化工廠中控室加裝多色燈號顯示器，各工作站進度一目了然，遇到履歷遺失也會直接報警停機，避免重覆生產。⟧
body.en: Progress tracking and diagnostics have become much clearer when running multi-step workflows and forked skills. In the `/workflows` agent detail panel, individual tool calls are now clearly marked as running, failed, or done, displaying any subagent task lists and letting you press Enter to unfold calls with their inputs and results. When using forked skills (running in an isolated background branch with `context: fork`), kickoff prompts and text turns generated with `--forward-subagent-text` now stream properly as progress events to `stream-json` output. If a workflow container restarts and its run journal is missing, the system now fails with a clear error instead of blindly rerunning every agent. ⟦The entire experience is like fitting a modern factory control room with multi-color status lights that display each workstation's progress while triggering an alarm and stopping lines if audit logs go missing, preventing duplicate production.⟧

items.original:
Fixed forked skills (`context: fork`) not streaming their kickoff prompt and, with `--forward-subagent-text`, their text turns as progress events in stream-json
Fixed resuming a workflow run after its container restarted; a resume whose run journal is missing now fails with a clear error instead of rerunning every agent
Improved `/workflows` agent detail: tool calls are marked running, failed or done, the subagent's task list is shown when it has one, and Enter unfolds the listed calls with their inputs and results

title.zh-TW: 企業閘道遙測直連收集器，補齊身分欄位且轉發不再暫停
title.en: Enterprise Gateway Telemetry Exports Directly to Collectors with Identity Fields and Unpaused Relays

body.zh-TW: 企業管理者透過閘道收集稽核資訊時，傳輸穩定度與身分欄位獲得顯著增強。Claude Desktop 與 Cowork 透過應用程式閘道傳送遙測資料時，現在補上了 `user.email` 與 `user.groups` 兩項欄位，與終端機工作階段的記錄規格保持一致。當閘道的受管設定中透過 `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT` 指定了收集器位址，閘道工作階段會直接將 OpenTelemetry 遙測數據匯出至該收集器，不再繞經閘道轉發；未指定收集器的工作階段則繼續走轉發路線。此外，過去轉發器在拒絕少數格式錯誤或過大的封包後，會將所有後續轉發暫停 30 秒，這項停頓問題如今已被修復。⟦這有如企業郵務室為各部門包裹貼上完整的員工名條，在設有直達專車時直接發車，不再因單件包裹超重而把整條輸送帶扣留半分鐘。⟧
body.en: Transmission stability and identity metadata have been significantly enhanced when administrators collect audit data via gateways. Telemetry sent by Claude Desktop and Cowork through an apps gateway now includes `user.email` and `user.groups` fields, matching the recording specs of terminal sessions. When gateway managed settings specify a collector endpoint via `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, gateway sessions export OpenTelemetry data directly to that collector instead of routing through the gateway relay, while sessions without a named collector continue using the relay. Furthermore, an issue where the relay paused all forwarding for 30 seconds after rejecting a few malformed or oversized payloads has now been resolved. ⟦This is like an enterprise mailroom labeling departmental packages with full employee rosters and dispatching dedicated direct shuttles when available, rather than halting the entire conveyor belt for half a minute over a single overweight parcel.⟧

items.original:
Added `user.email` and `user.groups` to the telemetry Claude Desktop and Cowork send through a Claude apps gateway, matching terminal sessions
Fixed the Claude apps gateway's OTLP telemetry relay pausing all forwarding to a collector for 30 seconds after it rejected a few payloads as malformed or too large
Changed Claude apps gateway sessions to export OpenTelemetry directly to a collector the gateway's managed settings name in `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, instead of through the gateway's relay; sessions without a named collector still use the relay

title.zh-TW: 受管設定強制啟動閘道登入，精準辨識子目錄代理人權限
title.en: Managed Settings Enforce Gateway Login on Startup with Accurate Subdirectory Agent Scoping

body.zh-TW: 在由企業受管設定規範的環境中，登入流程與權限界定變得更加嚴格一致。⟦這就像在企業大樓門禁加裝專用管制閘門，訪客從踏入大廳起就必須以公司證件感應通行，隨身舊訪客貼紙一律失效，樓層借調時也不會查錯權限名冊。⟧凡是在受管設定中配置了 `forceLoginGatewayUrl` 的電腦，啟動時便會直接建立應用程式閘道工作階段，行為等同於 `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"`；殘留的 claude.ai 登入狀態或 API 金鑰一概不予採用。在此類由受管設定導向閘道的工作階段中，重新執行 `/login` 不再誤報未設定閘道網址。此外，使用 `/add-dir <subdirectory>` 載入子目錄時，若受管設定僅將技能鎖定在外掛，系統不再拒絕載入該目錄的代理人，反之在僅鎖定代理人時也不會錯誤承諾提供代理人。
body.en: Login flows and permission boundaries are now strictly aligned in environments governed by enterprise managed settings. ⟦This is like installing dedicated security turnstiles at corporate building entrances, requiring visitors to swipe company badges from the moment they step into the lobby, invalidating leftover visitor passes, and checking accurate permission registries during inter-floor transfers.⟧ Machines with `forceLoginGatewayUrl` configured in managed settings now start directly as apps gateway sessions, behaving just like `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"`, while leftover claude.ai logins or API keys are discarded. Re-running `/login` in these gateway sessions no longer falsely reports that no gateway URL is configured. Additionally, when loading subdirectories via `/add-dir <subdirectory>`, the system no longer refuses to load subdirectory agents when managed settings lock only skills to plugins, nor does it mistakenly promise agents when only agents are locked.

items.original:
Fixed `/add-dir <subdirectory>` refusing to load a subdirectory's agents when managed settings lock only skills to plugins, and promising agents when only agents are locked
Fixed `/login` showing "no gateway URL is configured" when re-run in a session that signed in to a Claude apps gateway set by managed settings
Changed machines with `forceLoginGatewayUrl` in managed settings to be Claude apps gateway sessions from startup, like `forceLoginMethod: "gateway"`; a leftover claude.ai login or API key is not used

title.zh-TW: 遠端操控與背景工作階段穩定性升級，工作目錄切換跨回合保留
title.en: Remote Control and Background Session Stability Upgraded with Persistent Working Directories Across Turns

body.zh-TW: 遠端操控與背景工作階段的操作連貫性，在此版大幅改善。非互動式工作階段（如 `-p` 搭配 stream-json、Agent SDK 與雲端環境）不再於每則訊息重設工作目錄，`cd` 指令現在跨回合持續保留。遠端控制工作階段不再於最後訊息送達前搶先發出結束信號，避免應用程式提早顯示已完成。透過遠端控制執行 `/clear` 時，不再苦等 `SessionStart` 掛鉤（啟動時觸發的腳本）與終端機對話框。背景工作階段（`--bg`）不再因訊息剛好在閒置逾時前抵達而於回合中途被關閉。遠端沙箱在等待連接器核准或登入連結時不再持續保持活躍。在更新權杖（身分驗證令牌）時關閉 VS Code 或 SDK 工作階段，後續也不再要求重新登入。⟦這猶如遠距遙控探勘車作業，發話通道不提早切斷，更換坐標後也不會每回合被硬拉回原點。⟧
body.en: Operational continuity for Remote Control and background sessions has improved significantly in this release. Non-interactive sessions (such as `-p` with stream-json, Agent SDK, and cloud sessions) no longer reset their working directory on every message, allowing `cd` commands to persist across turns. Remote Control sessions no longer send an early end-of-turn signal before the final message arrives, preventing the app from prematurely showing the reply as finished. Running `/clear` via Remote Control no longer waits on `SessionStart` hooks or open terminal dialogs before completing. Background sessions (`--bg`) are no longer retired mid-turn when a message arrives just before the idle timeout. Remote sandboxes no longer stay alive while waiting for connector approvals or sign-in links. Furthermore, closing VS Code or SDK sessions while refreshing authentication tokens no longer forces a re-login. ⟦This is like operating a remote exploration rover where voice channels never cut off early and updated coordinates are not snapped back to the origin on every round.⟧

items.original:
Fixed VS Code and SDK sessions occasionally requiring re-login when a session was closed while refreshing its token
Fixed Remote Control sessions sending the end-of-turn signal before the reply's last message, which could show a reply as finished in the Claude app before its last part arrived
Fixed background (`--bg`) sessions occasionally being retired mid-turn when a message arrived just before the idle timeout
Fixed `/clear` from Remote Control waiting on SessionStart hooks and on open terminal dialogs before completing
Fixed non-interactive sessions (`-p` with stream-json input, Agent SDK, cloud sessions) resetting the shell working directory at each new user message; a `cd` now persists across turns
Fixed remote sessions keeping their sandbox container alive while a connector approval or sign-in link waits for you

title.zh-TW: MCP 支援傳統傳輸協議備援，延遲授權註冊且修正連線狀態
title.en: MCP Supports Legacy Transport Fallback with Deferred Client Registration and Fixed Connection States

body.zh-TW: 外部工具的連線交握與身分驗證機制，在本次更新中變得更具彈性。對於配置為 `http` 協定、卻只支援傳統 HTTP+SSE 傳輸架構的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的通訊協定）伺服器，過去往往永遠無法連線，現在會依照規格自動切換至 SSE 作為連線備援。在安全註冊方面，連線至需要登入的遠端伺服器時，系統不再預先註冊 OAuth 用戶端，而是等到你實際點選驗證時才發起註冊。此外，在雲端工作階段中，部分外部連接器伺服器若對不支援的請求回應 HTTP 401，先前會讓介面誤顯示為尚未登入，即便你在網頁版早已完成綁定；這項錯誤標示也已修正。⟦這宛如前往跨國商務櫃台辦理業務，雙方通訊埠能自動切換傳統備援線路，專屬通行證也只在確認臨櫃辦理時才現場印製。⟧
body.en: Connection handshakes and authentication mechanisms for external tools have become much more flexible. For MCP servers configured as `http` that only speak the legacy HTTP+SSE transport architecture, which previously failed to connect entirely, the system now automatically falls back to SSE as described in the specification. For secure registration, connecting to remote servers that require sign-in no longer registers OAuth clients in advance, but instead waits until you actually authenticate. In addition, cloud sessions previously showed some external connector servers as requiring login if they responded to unsupported requests with HTTP 401, even if you were already connected on the web; this misleading status has now been fixed. ⟦This is like visiting an international business desk where communication ports switch automatically to legacy backup lines and personalized access passes are printed on demand only when you arrive at the counter.⟧

items.original:
Fixed MCP servers configured as `http` that only speak the legacy HTTP+SSE transport never connecting; Claude Code now falls back to SSE as the MCP spec describes
Fixed some claude.ai connectors in cloud sessions showing as needing authentication even though they are connected in claude.ai (servers that answer an unsupported request with HTTP 401)
Improved remote MCP servers that need sign-in: Claude Code no longer registers an OAuth client with them until you actually authenticate

title.zh-TW: 工具輸出寫入增設 1 GB 上限，嚴格驗證工件發布並防禦惡意指令
title.en: Tool Output Disk Writes Capped at 1 GB with Stricter Artifact Publishing and Malicious Prompt Defense

body.zh-TW: 工具輸出存檔防護與工件安全性，在這一版築起了更嚴謹的防線。當外部工具執行的輸出結果過於龐大時，寫入磁碟的暫存檔案現在新增了 1 GB 上限；若檔案內容遭到截斷，對話視窗內的預覽區塊會主動標註已截斷警示，避免硬碟空間被無止境耗盡。在工件（由 AI 生成並可獨立展示或發布的程式與文件）管理方面，發布時若指定了連接器根本沒有提供的工具名稱，若宣稱的工具完全不存在會直接拒絕發布，部分不存在時則會跳出警告。此外，當讀取他人撰寫的工件時，摘要流程現在會將頁面內容視為未受信任的資料，主動標記其中暗藏的指令，而不是把那些指令原樣轉述出去，有效防範提示詞注入攻擊。⟦整個防護機制就像快遞驗收處為超大貨物設置重裝上限，核驗發行手續上的印章授權，並對外來信件裡的夾帶便條嚴加把關。⟧
body.en: Tool output persistence safeguards and artifact security have been significantly reinforced in this release. When external tool outputs are exceedingly large, saved disk files now have a 1 GB cap; if contents are truncated, in-conversation previews explicitly display truncation notices to prevent disk space exhaustion. For artifact management, publishing now strictly validates declared tools against connectors: publication is refused if none of the declared tools exist, and warned if only some are missing. Furthermore, when reading artifacts written by others, the summarization process now treats page content as untrusted data, actively flagging embedded instructions rather than relaying them to guard against prompt injection attacks. ⟦The entire defensive setup is like a freight intake depot imposing weight caps on oversized cargo, validating stamp authorizations on clearance papers, and scrutinizing enclosed notes in external mail.⟧

items.original:
Added a 1 GB cap on tool results saved to disk; the in-conversation preview says when a saved file was truncated
Fixed artifact publish accepting connector tool names the connector doesn't expose; the publish is now refused when none of the declared tools exist, and warned when only some don't
Improved the Artifact tool's read of an artifact someone else wrote: the summary now treats the page as untrusted content and flags embedded instructions rather than relaying them

title.zh-TW: 圖片處理改用內建引擎，超限錯誤清楚標註成因與解法
title.en: Image Processing Moves to Built-in Engine with Specific Causes and Fixes for Size Limit Errors

body.zh-TW: 在終端機中處理圖片時，底層架構變得更加輕量俐落。⟦這好比隨身相機改用機身自帶的解碼晶片直接讀圖，不再把精密模組拆到暫存托盤上拼裝，遇到超大相片時也能具體指出尺寸過大並建議縮圖。⟧命令列介面現在全面改用執行階段的內建圖片功能，不再於每次啟動時將原生二進位模組解壓縮至暫存目錄，有效精簡了磁碟寫入負擔與檔案殘留。同時，當載入的圖片超出限制而無法解碼時，過去錯誤提示往往只單純引述上限規範；現在訊息會明確指出失敗的根本原因，並提供相應的修改排查建議，方便你快速調整圖片規格並繼續對話。
body.en: Underlying architecture for handling images in the terminal is now much lighter and cleaner. ⟦This is like a compact camera reading images directly using its built-in decoding chip rather than disassembling precision modules onto temporary trays, while also pinpointing oversized photos and suggesting how to downscale them.⟧ The CLI now fully utilizes the runtime's built-in image features, no longer extracting native binary modules to temporary directories on startup, which reduces disk write overhead and leftover files. Meanwhile, when an image exceeding size limits cannot be decoded, error messages now state the underlying cause and provide troubleshooting suggestions instead of merely citing the limits, letting you quickly adjust image dimensions and continue your session.

items.original:
Improved the error shown when an image over the size limits cannot be decoded: it now names the cause and how to fix it instead of only citing the limit
Changed image processing to use the runtime's built-in image support; the CLI no longer extracts a native image module to the temp directory

title.zh-TW: Git 工作樹支援平行檢出，沙箱檔案讀寫與權限說明修復
title.en: Git Worktrees Support Parallel Checkout with Fixes for Sandbox File Access and Permission Wording

body.zh-TW: 本版針對檔案讀寫、版本控管與權限設定進行了多項底層改善。在大型專案中執行 `--worktree` 建立工作樹（Git 平行建立的多份專案副本）時，Git 2.32 以上版本支援平行檢出，大幅縮短啟動耗時。重啟曾讀取大量檔案的歷史工作階段，讀取速度也顯著提升。在 Windows 環境下，修正了於 AppContainer 或受限令牌沙箱中，檔案讀寫與編輯遭全面拒絕的錯誤。此外，內部檢查 Git 狀態與差異時，不再受到工作樹內巢狀專案配置的過濾規則干擾。授權選單中針對 `.claude` 目錄的權限說明文字也重新修訂，清楚標明其效果為允許在該工作階段內編輯專案 `.claude` 或使用者主目錄 `~/.claude` 下的檔案。⟦整套流程好似大型圖書館同步調閱多套館藏副本，清理不同樓層的檢查規則，並把調閱清單的通行權限說明得一清二楚。⟧
body.en: This release brings multiple low-level improvements to file access, version control, and permission settings. When creating worktrees via `--worktree` in large repositories, Git 2.32+ now checks them out in parallel, drastically reducing startup time. Resuming long sessions that previously read numerous files is also noticeably faster. On Windows, an issue where Read, Write, and Edit operations were completely rejected inside AppContainer or restricted-token sandboxes has been resolved. In addition, internal Git status and diff checks are no longer disrupted by clean filters configured in nested repositories within the working tree. Permission wording for the `.claude` folder has also been revised, clearly explaining that it allows editing files in the project's `.claude` directory or `~/.claude` for that session. ⟦The workflow is like a large library retrieving multiple collection copies in parallel, cleaning up inspection rules across floors, and clearly outlining access permissions on checkout slips.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Claude Code's own git status and diff probes running clean filters configured by a nested repository inside the working tree
Windows: Fixed Read, Write and Edit refusing every file ("symlink resolution changed after permission was checked") when running inside an AppContainer or restricted-token sandbox
Improved `--worktree` startup on large repositories: the new worktree is now checked out in parallel (git 2.32+)
Improved the time to resume long sessions that read many files
Updated the `.claude` folder permission option to say what it actually allows: editing files in the project's `.claude` folder (or `~/.claude`) for the session

title.zh-TW: 斜線指令支援完整搜尋清單，雙鍵快捷鍵寬限延長且排版穩定
title.en: Slash Commands Expand to Full Search Lists with Extended Two-Key Shortcut Windows and Layout Polish

body.zh-TW: 終端機的日常互動與指令清單體驗，在此版迎來細緻的排版與手感調校。在文字輸入中途鍵入斜線指令時，現在會以完整清單展開所有符合項目（在全螢幕以外模式可按 Tab 鍵展開），且外掛技能直接打簡短名稱就能找到。在 tmux 等多工環境下，兩鍵組合快捷鍵若第二個按鍵相隔超過 1 秒，過去會靜默取消，現在改為等待 3 秒並於逾時時跳出提示。全螢幕對話紀錄不再因為選單開合而上下晃動一行。切換 `/config` 分頁時對話框高度保持固定。授權確認訊息不再吃掉特有語法符號後的字元。恢復工作階段時未完成的背景工作也改以簡短狀態列顯示，不再被落落長的內部指示洗版。⟦這宛若演奏家踩踏快速曲目踏板，容許節奏微調且跳出警示，樂譜面板也穩固如初不再隨意跳行。⟧
body.en: Everyday terminal interactions and command menu handling have received thorough layout and responsiveness refinements in this release. Typing slash commands mid-prompt now displays matching results in a full list (which can be opened with Tab outside fullscreen), and plugin skills can be found directly by their bare names. In multitasking environments like tmux, two-key shortcuts whose second key arrives more than 1 second later now wait 3 seconds and display a timeout notice instead of cancelling silently. Fullscreen transcripts no longer jump by a row when menus open or close. Dialog heights remain stable when switching tabs in `/config`. Permission prompts no longer drop characters following specific syntax sigils. Resumed sessions now display unfinished background tasks as concise status lines rather than cluttering the screen with lengthy internal instructions. ⟦This is like a musician operating fast-tempo pedals where slight timing gaps trigger helpful cues while the sheet music stand remains rock-solid without shifting lines.⟧

items.original:
Fixed syntax-highlighted code in permission prompts and messages sometimes omitting a character after a Ruby `?`, Erlang `$`, or Perl `$` sigil
Fixed the fullscreen transcript jumping by one row whenever the slash-command or @-file suggestion list opened or closed
Fixed two-key keyboard shortcuts cancelling silently when the second key arrived more than a second later, as happens inside tmux; they now wait 3 seconds and show a notice when they time out
Fixed the `/config` dialog changing height when switching between its tabs
Fixed resumed sessions showing long model-facing recovery instructions in "background task didn't finish" notices instead of a short status line
Improved slash commands typed mid-prompt: matches now show in a list (Tab opens it outside fullscreen) instead of a single suggestion, and a plugin skill is now found by its bare name

title.zh-TW: 模型切換支援特定代號，顧問工具決策固定且精準回報錯誤
title.en: Model Switching Supports Specific Target Names with Stable Advisor Decisions and Accurate Error Reporting

body.zh-TW: 切換模型規格與顧問機制時的判定邏輯，現在運作得更加穩定明確。⟦這如同委任專業顧問公司，合約窗口一旦確認就不會在每次發案時反覆改派，更換名單時也會主動寄發通知信。⟧過去顧問工具及其指示內容常因不同請求的模型而逐次重做決定；如今系統只會做一次判定，並在規則變動時於對話中主動公告。指令支援方面，輸入 `/model opusplan[1m]` 不再被誤判為模型不存在。若因設定檔無法寫入而導致預設模型儲存失敗，`/model` 不會再假裝已儲存成功，而是會如實告知儲存失敗及其原因。此外，內建的 `claude-api` 技能同步更正了錯誤代碼文件，清楚指明模型存取失敗會回傳 404，不支援的測試版標頭則回傳 400，而非先表記錄的 403。
body.en: Decision logic when switching models and configuring advisor behaviors is now significantly more stable and transparent. ⟦This is like hiring a consulting firm where assigned account representatives remain fixed rather than being reshuffled with every new request, sending formal notices whenever staffing rules change.⟧ Previously, the advisor tool and its instructions were re-decided per request based on that request's model; decisions are now made once and announced directly in conversation whenever they change. In terms of commands, typing `/model opusplan[1m]` is no longer rejected with "Model not found". If saving a default model fails due to unwritable configuration files, `/model` no longer falsely claims success, but instead reports the failure and its underlying cause. In addition, the built-in `claude-api` skill reference documentation has been corrected: model access failures return 404 and unavailable beta headers return 400, rather than the previously documented 403.

items.original:
Fixed `/model opusplan[1m]` being rejected with "Model not found"
Fixed the advisor tool and its instructions being re-decided per request from the request's model; the decision is now made once and announced in the conversation when it changes
Fixed `/model` claiming a model was "saved as your default" when the settings file couldn't be written; it now says the save failed and why
Fixed the `claude-api` skill's error-code reference: model access failures return 404 and unavailable beta headers return 400, not 403

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 閒置工作階段自動封存，重啟視窗不空白且版面修正
title.en: [VSCode] Auto-Archiving for Inactive Sessions with Fixes for Blank Restarts and Layout Glitches

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 擴充套件中，側邊欄的工作階段管理與視覺細節得到了貼心修正。為避免對話清單長期累積變得雜亂，新增了「封存閒置工作階段」（Archive inactive sessions）設定，預設會在閒置滿 14 天後自動將其移入封存區。先前若一個對話視窗開啟超過 10 分鐘，在執行視窗重新載入或重啟編輯器後，側邊欄對話往往會變成一片空白，這項顯示異常現已完全修復。同時，在顯示遠端控制已啟用的提示訊息中，時間軸圓點沉在文字下方的排版走位問題也已校正歸位。⟦這就像辦公室定期整理個人公文櫃，超過兩週沒動的歷史案件會自動移至封存資料夾，拉開抽屜時內容不再莫名消失，外側標籤也貼得平整端正。⟧
body.en: Sidebar session management and visual details have received thoughtful fixes in the VS Code extension. To keep conversation lists uncluttered over time, a new "Archive inactive sessions" setting automatically moves sessions to an archive after 14 days of inactivity by default. Previously, if a chat had been open for more than 10 minutes, reloading the window or restarting the editor often left the sidebar blank; this rendering bug has now been resolved. Additionally, a layout misalignment where the timeline dot sat beneath text in "Remote Control is active" notices has been corrected. ⟦This is like an office organizing filing cabinets where cases untouched for over two weeks automatically move into archival folders, drawer contents never vanish mysteriously, and exterior labels stay neat and aligned.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added automatic archiving of sessions inactive for a set period (new "Archive inactive sessions" setting, default 14 days)
[VSCode] Fixed the sidebar chat coming back blank after Reload Window or a restart when the conversation had been open for more than 10 minutes
[VSCode] Fixed the timeline dot sitting below the text on the "Remote Control is active" message

title.zh-TW: GPT-6-Astra 上架模型挑選器與 Bedrock，官方文件同步補上轉移指引
title.en: GPT-6-Astra Arrives in Model Picker and Bedrock with Updated Migration Guides

body.zh-TW: 開發時想嘗試最新一代模型？現在進入模型挑選器（model picker，供切換不同 AI 版本的選單）即可直接選用 GPT-6-Astra。這項更新也同步推送到 Amazon Bedrock 的服務目錄中。若你正打算將既有專案遷移過來，內建的 OpenAI Docs 技能也已全面更新，針對 GPT-6-Astra 提供專門的轉移步驟、相容性說明與提示詞撰寫指引。⟦這就像車商正式將新旗艦車款陳列在展示中心與特約經銷商的型錄上，同時隨車手冊也立即換上新版的升級指南、相容說明與駕駛操作技巧。⟧無論你透過本機選單還是雲端目錄調用，都能直接對照指引順利切換。
body.en: Looking to try the latest model during development? You can now select GPT-6-Astra directly from the model picker. This update is also available in the Amazon Bedrock service catalog. If you plan to migrate existing projects, the bundled OpenAI Docs skill has been updated with dedicated migration steps, compatibility notes, and prompting guidance for GPT-6-Astra. ⟦It is like a carmaker showcasing a new flagship model in showrooms and dealership catalogs, while immediately updating the owner's manual with upgrade guides, compatibility details, and driving tips.⟧ Whether you invoke it from the local menu or cloud catalog, you can switch smoothly by following the guides.

items.original:
GPT-6-Astra is now available in the model picker and Amazon Bedrock catalogs. (#42879, #42619)
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs skill with GPT-6-Astra migration, compatibility, and prompting guidance. (#42931)

title.zh-TW: 實驗性工作樹支援登場，獨立簽出目錄支援瀏覽與續接
title.en: Experimental Worktree Support Arrives to Browse and Resume Isolated Checkouts

body.zh-TW: 你想同時處理多條開發分支又不想弄亂現有目錄？Codex 新增了實驗性的工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）支援。⟦這恰似圖書館為大型研究計畫增設獨立自修室，研究員可以帶著資料副本到專用房間閉門作業，中途可以走出房間瀏覽各室進度，稍後也能重新進房接續未完的研究，完全不會佔用大廳的公共閱覽桌。⟧現在只要在啟動時加上 `--worktree` 旗標，或在對話中輸入 `/worktree` 指令，就能為全新或分支衍生出的工作階段建立彼此隔離的簽出目錄。建立之後，你還能隨心瀏覽所有存在的工作樹，並重新續接先前的工作進度。
body.en: Want to work on multiple branches simultaneously without cluttering your current directory? Codex now introduces experimental worktree support. ⟦This is like a library setting up private study rooms for major research projects, allowing researchers to work behind closed doors with copies of materials, step out to browse progress across rooms, and return later to resume unfinished work without occupying shared reading tables.⟧ Simply pass the `--worktree` flag at startup or enter the `/worktree` command in a conversation to create isolated checkout directories for new or forked sessions. Once created, you can browse all existing worktrees and resume earlier progress at any time.

items.original: Experimental worktree support lets you create isolated checkouts for new or forked sessions using `--worktree` or `/worktree`, then browse and resume them. (#42652, #43069, #43120, #43286)

title.zh-TW: 背景執行中直接行內回答提問，提供建議選項且不丟失草稿
title.en: Answer Questions Inline While Working in Background Without Losing Drafts

body.zh-TW: 請 Codex 寫程式的同時，你不再需要被動等待它停下才能互動。當它在背景持續運作並向你提出疑問時，現在能直接在行內（inline，直接在當前內容中插入顯示）彈出提問並即時作答。⟦宛如主廚在料理台上全神貫注烹調主菜時，助手從旁遞上調味選擇的便條，主廚能順手打勾或寫上備註，手中的主菜鍋鏟完全不需停下。⟧你可以直接點選介面給出的建議選項，也能自行輸入自訂文字回答。更重要的是，這項互動完全不會清空或影響你原本在輸入框中打到一半的主草稿，確保思緒與進度雙軌推進。
body.en: You no longer have to wait idly for Codex to stop before interacting while it writes code. When Codex runs in the background and asks a question, it can now surface prompt questions inline for immediate replies. ⟦Just like an assistant handing seasoning option slips to a chef focused on cooking a main dish, allowing the chef to check boxes or jot notes without ever putting down the spatula.⟧ You can click suggested options provided by the interface or type custom text responses. Best of all, this interaction will not clear or affect your ongoing main draft in the input box, keeping both your thoughts and progress on track.

items.original: Answer questions inline while Codex continues working, using suggested choices or custom text without losing your main draft. (#42891, #42894, #42897)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援共享背景伺服器，提供守護行程管理指令與自動更新
title.en: Windows Adds Shared Background Server with Daemon Lifecycle Commands and Managed Updates

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境上使用 Codex，多個工作階段現在能共用同一個背景運行的伺服器，不必每個終端機視窗各自啟動一份。這次更新同步引入了守護行程（daemon，在背景持續默默提供服務的常駐程式）生命週期管理指令，讓你能查詢狀態、啟動或終止背景伺服器，同時還納入了託管更新機制，確保背景服務能平順接收後續升級。⟦這好比集合式辦公大樓設置中央公用影印列印中心，各樓層辦公室共用同一組背景運轉的專業主機與管理工具，不必每張桌子都各自擺一台高耗能印表機。⟧
body.en: Multiple sessions on Windows can now share a single background server instead of each terminal window starting its own. This update also introduces daemon lifecycle management commands to check status, start, or stop the background server, alongside managed updates to ensure background services receive future upgrades smoothly. ⟦This is like an office building setting up a central printing center where offices on each floor share the same background professional equipment and management tools, rather than placing power-hungry printers on every desk.⟧

items.original: Windows sessions can now share a background Codex server, with daemon lifecycle commands and managed updates. (#42405, #42392)

title.zh-TW: Vim 編輯新增 R 取代模式，支援復原與重複操作並改善退出鍵
title.en: Vim Editing Adds R Replace Mode with Undo, Dot-Repeat, and Reliable Escape Handling

body.zh-TW: 習慣 Vim 鍵盤操作的開發者，在編輯草稿時手感將更加俐落。這次更新為 Vim 模式補上了經典的 `R` 取代模式，讓你可以直接覆蓋游標處的字元。進行文字替換時，你能按鍵復原（undo，回復到修改前的文字），也能利用小數點鍵重複執行上一次的取代動作。針對舊型終端機，更新也改善了 Escape 鍵的訊號處理，讓跳離編輯模式的操作更可靠，避免按鍵延遲或失靈。⟦此舉有如手寫打字機具備了即時覆蓋色帶，既能直接壓字修正錯別字，又能藉由倒退鍵復原上一步或連打重複印字，同時也把老舊按鍵卡榫徹底潤滑修好。⟧
body.en: Developers accustomed to Vim keybindings will enjoy a snappier draft editing experience. This update brings the classic `R` replace mode to Vim mode, allowing you to overwrite characters directly under the cursor. During text replacement, you can undo changes and use the dot key to repeat your previous replacement action. For legacy terminals, the update improves Escape key handling, making exiting edit modes more reliable and avoiding key delays or failures. ⟦This is like a typewriter equipped with an instant correction ribbon that overwrites typos, allows backspacing to undo or repeating keystrokes, while fully lubricating worn-out mechanical key joints.⟧

items.original: Vim editing gains `R` replace mode with undo and dot-repeat, plus more reliable Escape handling in legacy terminals. (#42194, #42584)

title.zh-TW: 複製回覆保留富文字格式，/copy 指令支援狀態與欄位擷取
title.en: Copying Responses Preserves Rich-Text Formatting as /copy Gains Status and Field Extraction

body.zh-TW: 將對話產生的程式碼或說明貼到其他文書軟體時，排版不再被打亂成純文字了。現在從 Codex 複製回覆內容，貼入支援富文字（rich-text，包含粗體、標題與程式碼區塊等排版樣式）的應用程式時，會完整保留原本的格式外觀。與此同時，命令列工具的 `/copy` 指令也迎來功能強化，除了複製回覆本身，現在還能單獨複製狀態輸出，或是擷取工作階段內的特定個別欄位。⟦一如專業相機輸出照片，既能直接沖洗出帶有完整色彩與層次細節的精緻相片，也可以單獨將相機當前的拍攝數據或特定參數獨立匯出備查。⟧這讓整理文件與分享除錯資訊變得更順暢。
body.en: Pasting generated code or explanations into other document apps will no longer scramble formatting into plain text. Copying responses from Codex into rich-text applications now fully preserves the original styling and appearance. Meanwhile, the command-line `/copy` command has been enhanced to copy status output or extract specific individual fields from a session in addition to the response itself. ⟦Just like a professional camera outputting photos, which can develop fine prints with full color and tonal detail, or independently export current shooting metadata and specific parameters for reference.⟧ This makes organizing documentation and sharing debugging information much smoother.

items.original: Copying responses preserves formatting in rich-text apps, and `/copy` can copy status output or individual session fields. (#42847, #43055)

title.zh-TW: 現有工作階段動態辨識外掛工具，升級回捲自動重新整理
title.en: Existing Sessions Dynamically Detect Plugin Tools and Refresh on Upgrades or Rollbacks

body.zh-TW: 當你手邊的工作階段正在進行，外部外掛有了變更也不需要關掉重開。⟦這如同工廠的工具旋轉吊架，在技師開工期間若由後勤人員掛上新零件或替換工具規格，技師不必停工重開電閘，轉身就能直接拿取最新到貨的工具與操作手冊。⟧既有的工作階段現在具備動態感知能力，能在不中斷執行的情況下，即刻辨識剛安裝好的外掛工具。當外掛在外部完成升級或執行版本回捲時，當前視窗會立即重新整理相應的技能。連同內部定義的掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）也會一併更新，確保所有自動化流程即時生效。
body.en: When your current session is running, you no longer need to restart it when external plugins change. ⟦This is like a factory rotating tool rack where logistics staff hang new parts or replace tool specifications while technicians work, allowing technicians to grab newly arrived tools and manuals without shutting down power or halting work.⟧ Existing sessions now feature dynamic detection to recognize newly installed plugin tools without interrupting execution. When plugins are upgraded or rolled back externally, the active window immediately refreshes corresponding skills. Internally defined hooks are updated as well, ensuring all automated workflows take effect immediately.

items.original: Existing sessions pick up newly installed plugin tools and refresh skills and hooks after external plugin upgrades or rollbacks. (#42284, #42593, #42990)

title.zh-TW: MCP 連線協調權杖更新與登入挑戰，舊版伺服器啟動入口退場
title.en: MCP Connections Coordinate Token Refreshes and Login Challenges as Legacy Entry Point Retires

body.zh-TW: 透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）串接外部服務時，授權憑證的維護現在更安全且井然有序。當多個工具連線需要更新 OAuth 授權權杖（token，用來驗證身分的授權令牌）時，Codex 會統一協調這些連線的更新動作。若更新失敗，介面會主動跳出登入驗證挑戰提示，絕不自動重播先前已被拒絕的工具呼叫。此外，先前已被標記為棄用的 `codex mcp-server` 啟動入口也在本次更新中正式移除。⟦猶如園區更新外包廠商的門禁機制，廠商證件過期時由系統集中協調換證，換證失敗即引導人員臨櫃重新認證，絕不拿遭拒的舊卡重複硬刷閘門；同時管理處也正式封閉已張貼告示的舊側門。⟧
body.en: Maintaining authorization credentials when connecting to external services via MCP is now safer and more orderly. When multiple tool connections require OAuth token refreshes, Codex coordinates the refresh across those connections. If a refresh fails, the interface surfaces login challenges without automatically replaying previously rejected tool calls. In addition, the previously deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is officially removed in this release. ⟦This is like an office park updating contractor access control, where expired badges are renewed through centralized coordination, failed renewals direct personnel to service counters for re-verification without repeatedly swiping rejected cards at gates, and management seals off the deprecated side entrance.⟧

items.original:
MCP connections coordinate OAuth token refreshes and surface login challenges when refresh fails, without automatically replaying rejected tool calls. (#42413, #42552)
The deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is no longer available. (#42993)

title.zh-TW: 啟動流程阻擋未信任輔助程式，macOS 沙盒嚴防終端機注入
title.en: Startup Blocks Untrusted Workspace Helpers as macOS Sandbox Prevents Terminal Injection

body.zh-TW: 開啟陌生專案目錄或在蘋果電腦上執行終端機，資安防線在開工當下就已全面就位。現在 Codex 在啟動過程中，若尚未與當前工作區建立明確的信任關係，會主動避免執行任何由工作區控制的輔助程式，杜絕惡意腳本趁虛而入。與此同時，macOS 系統下的沙盒（sandbox，隔離程式執行權限的保護層）也經過強化，能確實阻擋未經許可的終端機輸入注入攻擊。⟦這好似進入高度管制的實驗室，外部帶來的隨身器材在通過信任檢驗前一律禁止插電啟動，而隔離艙門的防護隔板也能阻擋外界未授權的按鈕信號干擾。⟧這讓你在檢視未知程式碼時能受到更周密的保護。
body.en: When opening unfamiliar project directories or running terminals on Mac computers, security defenses are active right from the start. During startup, Codex actively avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before establishing trust with the current workspace, preventing malicious scripts from taking advantage. Meanwhile, the macOS sandbox has been strengthened to block unauthorized terminal input injection attacks. ⟦This is like entering a high-security laboratory where personal equipment brought from outside cannot be powered on before trust verification, while containment barriers block unauthorized external button signals.⟧ This ensures thorough protection when inspecting unknown code.

items.original: Startup avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before trust is established, and the macOS sandbox blocks terminal input injection. (#42324, #42590)

title.zh-TW: 遠端續接與分支保留已存權限，新工作階段尊重預設模型
title.en: Remote Resume and Fork Preserve Saved Permissions While Fresh Sessions Follow Default Models

body.zh-TW: 透過遠端環境接續或分流既有進度時，設定與權限將維持一致。當你針對遠端工作階段執行續接（resume，接續先前中斷的進度）或分支操作時，先前已經儲存的授權與權限設定現在會完整延續，省去反覆確認授權的打擾。同時，全新開啟的工作階段以及衍生的分支，除非你在指令中明確指定其他模型，否則一律會嚴格遵守伺服器端配置的預設模型規格。⟦正如跨國企業指派主管遠端接管或分流專案小組，原有的門禁通行權限會自動跟隨繼承，而新立案的分支部門也會直接套用總部規範的標準設備，不必每次連線都重新簽呈。⟧此舉確保了跨端協同作業的權限延續性與環境規範。
body.en: Configurations and permissions remain consistent when resuming or branching progress in remote environments. When performing resume or fork operations on remote sessions, previously saved authorizations and permission settings are preserved, eliminating repetitive authorization prompts. Furthermore, fresh sessions and derived forks strictly respect server-configured default models unless you explicitly specify another model in your command. ⟦Just as a multinational enterprise assigns managers to take over or split project teams remotely, existing access permissions are automatically inherited, while newly chartered branch units adopt standard equipment prescribed by headquarters without requiring new approvals for each connection.⟧ This ensures permission continuity and environmental standards during remote collaboration.

items.original: Remote resume and fork operations preserve saved permissions; fresh sessions and forks respect server model defaults unless explicitly overridden. (#43330, #43177, #43355)

title.zh-TW: 跨應用程式續接對話防衝突，提供唯讀逐字紀錄且保留草稿
title.en: Cross-App Conversation Resume Prevents Conflicts with Read-Only Transcripts and Draft Preservation

body.zh-TW: 當你想接續處理某個對話，但該對話正巧在另一個應用程式中開啟時，現在不必再擔心進度衝突了。⟦彷彿走進銀行閱覽保管箱資料，若另一位共同持有者正在櫃檯查閱正本，行員會先為你提供唯讀對照副本與等候重試號碼牌，並妥善看管你正在填寫的申請表格。⟧Codex 會在介面上顯示唯讀的對話轉錄（transcript，完整對話逐字紀錄），讓你能回顧過往脈絡，並附上重新嘗試的按鈕選項。與此同時，你當前輸入框中正在撰寫的文字草稿也會受到完整保護，不會被清空或覆蓋，方便你在另一端釋放鎖定後立刻接手。
body.en: You no longer have to worry about progress conflicts when resuming a conversation that happens to be open in another application. ⟦It is like visiting a bank vault to inspect documents where, if a co-owner is reviewing the original at the counter, the clerk provides a read-only reference copy and a retry ticket while safeguarding the application form you are filling out.⟧ Codex displays a read-only transcript in the interface so you can review past context, accompanied by a retry button option. Meanwhile, your ongoing text draft in the input box remains protected without being cleared or overwritten, allowing you to take over immediately once the lock is released on the other side.

items.original: Resuming a conversation open in another app now shows a read-only transcript with a retry option while preserving your draft. (#43253)

title.zh-TW: 自動核准審查保留壓縮脈絡，遇新指令自動駁回失效授權
title.en: Automatic Approval Reviews Preserve Compaction Context and Reject Invalidated Authorizations

body.zh-TW: 面對需要反覆審核權限的操作流程，自動審查機制的判斷現在更加嚴謹周全。在對話歷程經歷壓縮（compaction，精簡長對話以節省記憶體的機制）後，自動核准審查機制能更完善地保留原本的授權脈絡，避免重要授權因紀錄濃縮而遺失。更重要的是，一旦使用者在後續給出了全新的指令或補充回答，只要先前的核准因此失效，審查機制就會果斷駁回該項核准，防止舊授權被錯誤套用到新情境。⟦類似於建築師審查工程變更單，即使過往會議紀錄經過摘要精簡，簽核依據依然完整留底；而只要業主中途變更了設計需求，先前簽核的舊工單就會立刻作廢重新評估。⟧
body.en: When dealing with workflows that require repeated permission reviews, automatic approval mechanisms are now more rigorous. Following conversation compaction, automatic approval reviews better preserve original authorization context, preventing critical authorizations from being lost due to history condensation. More importantly, once users provide fresh instructions or supplementary answers that invalidate earlier approvals, the review mechanism promptly rejects those approvals to prevent obsolete authorizations from being misapplied in new contexts. ⟦Similar to an architect reviewing engineering change orders, where approval records remain intact even after past meeting notes are summarized, but previously signed work orders are immediately invalidated for re-evaluation whenever the owner alters design requirements midway.⟧

items.original: Automatic approval reviews better preserve authorization context through compaction and reject approvals invalidated by new user instructions or answers. (#42844, #42852, #43442)

title.zh-TW: Astra 現身內建模型挑選器，未明確設定時成為預設選項
title.en: Astra now visible in the bundled model picker, becomes default when unconfigured

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟 Codex 準備寫程式時，如果沒有在設定中明確指定特定模型，現在會直接以 Astra 作為內建預設模型。過去 Astra 在內建的模型挑選器（供切換不同 AI 版本的選單）中可能無法正常看見，這次更新修復了顯示問題，讓它清楚出現在挑選清單供你點選；只要你未額外指定其他模型，它就會自動接手你的開發工作。⟦這就像走進專業工作間，出廠預設直接由全能技師接手派工，工具牆上的值班清單也正式掛出他的名牌，即使進門前沒特別指定師傅，也能直接享有標準服務。⟧這讓尚未配置偏好模型的日常操作能直接使用 Astra ，切換時也能在清單中快速找到。
body.en: When you open Codex to start coding, if no specific model is explicitly configured, Astra now serves directly as the bundled default model. Previously, Astra could fail to appear properly in the bundled model picker (a menu for switching between different AI versions); this update fixes the visibility issue, so it now shows up clearly in the selection list for you to pick; as long as you haven't specified another model, it automatically takes over your development work. ⟦It's like walking into a professional workshop where, by factory default, an all-around technician takes over your job assignment, and their name is now properly posted on the duty roster on the tool wall—even if you didn't specify a technician before walking in, you still get standard service right away.⟧ This lets everyday operations without a configured preferred model use Astra directly, and it can also be found quickly in the list when switching.

items.original: Fixed Astra’s visibility in the bundled model picker and made it the bundled default when no model is explicitly configured. (#42874)

title.zh-TW: Astra 調整非同步提問指引，僅在工作階段提供工具時發問
title.en: Astra's async-question guidance updated to ask only when the session provides the tool

body.zh-TW: 交給 Astra 處理複雜任務時，它在背景發問確認的行為現在更精準。這次更新調整了 Astra 的內建指引，明確限制它只有在目前工作階段確實具備提問工具時，才能向你發起非同步提問（在背景等候回覆、不卡住手邊工作的發問機制）。以前若環境未提供相應工具，模型可能仍會嘗試發送背景問題；現在有了這層條件約束，提問動作只會在支援的環境下觸發。⟦這如同野外巡邏隊員在遇到狀況時，會先檢查隨身裝備是否配有無線電對講機，只有在通訊器材完備時才向總部回傳發問，不會對著沒有訊號的空耳機呼叫。⟧如此一來，工作階段在缺乏提問模組時能維持穩定運行，不會被不合時宜的發問中斷。
body.en: When you hand Astra a complex task, its behavior of asking background confirmation questions is now more precise. This update adjusts Astra's built-in guidance, explicitly restricting it to initiate asynchronous questions to you (a mechanism that waits for a reply in the background without blocking your current work) only when the tool for questions is actually available in the current session. Previously, if the environment didn't provide the corresponding tool, the model could still attempt to send background questions; now with this condition in place, the questioning action only triggers in a supported environment. ⟦This is like a field patrol officer who, upon encountering a situation, first checks whether their gear includes a radio—only reporting back to headquarters with questions when the communication equipment is in place, rather than calling into a signal-less, empty headset.⟧ As a result, the session can keep running stably even when the questioning module is unavailable, without being interrupted by an ill-timed question.

items.original: Updated Astra’s guidance to use asynchronous questions only when the tool is available in the session. (#42878)

title.zh-TW: Amazon Bedrock 路由選單加入 GPT-6-Astra 模型
title.en: Amazon Bedrock Route Picker Adds GPT-6-Astra Model

body.zh-TW: 你在 Amazon Bedrock 雲端環境中調用 Codex 時，挑選模型有了新選項。⟦如同連鎖餐廳在特定分店的點餐機上，正式把最新招牌菜加入螢幕選單，走進指定門市的顧客直接按螢幕就能點選。⟧這項改動涵蓋 Mantle 路由，以及 Runtime 的 global 與 US 路由（route，雲端服務分配請求路徑的通道）。只要連線走這幾條途徑，你就能在模型挑選器（model picker，供手動切換不同 AI 版本的選單）中直接選取 GPT-6-Astra 模型。走 Mantle 或 Runtime 的 global／US 路由時，可在模型挑選器直接選 GPT-6-Astra。
body.en: When calling Codex in the Amazon Bedrock cloud environment, you now have a new option when selecting models. ⟦Much like a chain restaurant officially adding its latest signature dish to the screen menu on ordering kiosks at specific branches, allowing customers entering designated stores to select it directly on the screen.⟧ This change covers the Mantle route as well as Runtime's global and US routes. As long as your connection uses these paths, you can directly select the GPT-6-Astra model in the model picker. When routing through Mantle or Runtime global/US, you can directly choose GPT-6-Astra in the model picker.

items.original: Added GPT-6-Astra to the Amazon Bedrock model picker for Mantle and Runtime global/US routes. (#42805)

title.zh-TW: 修正 GPT-6-Astra 非同步提問指引，改用支援工具且認得純文字限制
title.en: Corrected GPT-6-Astra Guidance for Asynchronous Clarifications to Use Supported Tools and Recognize Text-Only Limits

body.zh-TW: 交給 GPT-6-Astra 的任務如果需求不明確，它在背景發問釐清的流程現在更穩定。這項改動修正了該模型提出非同步釐清問題（asynchronous clarification questions，不中斷手邊工作、在背景等候回覆的提問機制）時的內建指引。現在它會確實呼叫官方受支援的工具（supported tool，環境中明訂可用來向外部發問的功能模組），不再誤用不相容的管道。同時，它也能正確辨識該工具僅接受純文字內容，避免送出不支援的格式而引發錯誤。⟦宛如助理遇到交代不清的待辦事項時，會準確把疑問寫成便條紙投進專用留言箱，不再投錯信箱或塞進格式不符的包裹。⟧
body.en: When tasks assigned to GPT-6-Astra have unclear requirements, its process for asking clarifying questions in the background is now more reliable. This change corrects the model's built-in guidance when asking asynchronous clarification questions. It now properly calls officially supported tools instead of misusing incompatible channels. At the same time, it correctly recognizes that the tool accepts only plain text, avoiding errors caused by sending unsupported formats. ⟦Much like an assistant dealing with an unclearly explained task who accurately writes questions on a memo note and drops it into a dedicated message box, rather than dropping it into the wrong mailbox or stuffing in a parcel with an incompatible format.⟧

items.original: Corrected GPT-6-Astra’s guidance for asynchronous clarification questions to use the supported tool and recognize that it accepts text only. (#42809)

title.zh-TW: `remote-control` 支援註冊為系統背景服務，離線重開機皆能保持連線
title.en: `remote-control` can now be registered as an OS background service, keeping connections alive across logouts and reboots

body.zh-TW:
出門在外想從遠端連回工作主機，最怕主機登出或重開機後連線中斷。⟦好比在通訊鐵塔安裝不斷電中繼發射器，就算人員離場或總電源重啟，設備依然持續發送信號，名冊上能自訂代號且不中斷連線。⟧工具新增了 `remote-control start`、`remote-control status` 與 `remote-control stop` 子指令，可將命令列工具註冊為作業系統背景服務（常駐在系統底層運行的程序）。即使登出帳號或重新開機，主機依然保持可連線狀態。執行 `remote-control start --name <label>` 能在實體清單自訂辨識標籤，加入 `--session` 旗標則能將服務限制在當前登入的工作階段。

```
# 註冊為作業系統常駐服務，重開機或登出皆保持連線
agy remote-control start --name "office-mac"

# 僅限定在目前登入的工作階段
agy remote-control start --session

# 查詢服務狀態與停止服務
agy remote-control status
agy remote-control stop
```
body.en:
When connecting back to your workstation remotely while away, the biggest headache is losing the connection after logging out or rebooting. ⟦It is like installing an uninterruptible relay transmitter on a communications tower: even if staff leave or the main power is cycled, the equipment keeps broadcasting signals with a customizable roster label without dropping the connection.⟧ The tool has added the `remote-control start`, `remote-control status`, and `remote-control stop` subcommands, allowing you to register the CLI as an operating system background service. Even if you log out of your account or restart the machine, the host remains reachable. Running `remote-control start --name <label>` lets you set a custom identification label in the instance list, while adding the `--session` flag restricts the service to your current login session.

```
# Register as an OS background service to stay reachable across reboots and logouts
agy remote-control start --name "office-mac"

# Scope strictly to the current login session
agy remote-control start --session

# Check service status and stop the service
agy remote-control status
agy remote-control stop
```
