items.original: Added the `remote-control start`, `remote-control status`, and `remote-control stop` subcommands to run the CLI as a background service registered with your operating system's service manager so your machine stays reachable across logouts and reboots; `remote-control start --name <label>` sets a custom machine label in the Remote Control instance list, and `--session` scopes the service to your active login session.

title.zh-TW: 半頁捲動支援更多畫面與預設快捷鍵，唯讀面板不再誤退
title.en: Half-page scrolling expands to more views with default keybindings, preventing accidental exits in read-only panels

items.original: Improved half-page scrolling across all scrollable views — including altscreen mode, the diff viewer, and read-only detail panels where `ctrl+d` no longer triggers the exit prompt — and set `shift+up` and `shift+down` as customizable default keybindings for half-page navigation (`navigation.half_page_up` and `navigation.half_page_down`).

title.zh-TW: 內容安全過濾器提供明確中斷原因，告別空回覆與無效重試
title.en: Content safety filters now provide clear stop reasons, eliminating empty responses and pointless retries

body.zh-TW: 當你輸入的提示詞或模型產生的回覆觸動內容安全防線時，終端機不再用含糊的錯誤訊息讓人摸不著頭緒。⟦這宛如海關安檢人員攔下違禁包裹，過去若不發一語直接沒收、或者反覆將包裹推回輸送帶重新掃描，都會讓寄件人困惑，現在安檢處會明確開立註記違規類別的查驗單。⟧以前只要提示或生成內容被內容安全過濾器（防止有害或違規內容的審查機制）阻擋，系統常會跳出無關的 `no candidate found` 假錯誤、整輪對話靜默結束不留文字，甚至反覆重試被拒絕的輸入。現在命令列工具會直接顯示明確的 `content-filter` 停止原因，讓使用者一眼看清是哪裡觸發了安全審查。
body.en: When an input prompt or model-generated response triggers safety guardrails, the terminal no longer leaves you baffled with vague errors. ⟦It is like customs security intercepting a restricted package: rather than silently confiscating it or repeatedly returning it to the conveyor belt to rescan, the inspection desk now issues an inspection slip clearly noting the violation category.⟧ Previously, when prompts or generated content were blocked by content safety filters, the system often threw spurious `no candidate found` errors, ended the entire turn silently with an empty response, or repeatedly retried rejected input. The CLI now surfaces an explicit `content-filter` stop reason, letting you clearly see what triggered the safety review.

items.original: Fixed prompts or model responses blocked by content safety filters failing with a spurious "no candidate found" error, ending silently with an empty turn, or repeatedly retrying the rejected input; the CLI now surfaces a clear content-filter stop reason.

title.zh-TW: `scratch/` 草稿檔排除於監聽範圍外，成品面板與檢查點回歸乾淨
title.en: `scratch/` drafts are now excluded from watchers, keeping artifact panels and checkpoints clean

body.zh-TW: 讓代理人寫臨時程式碼或運算草稿時，你的工作面板與版本紀錄不再被暫存檔案洗版。當 AI 代理人在名為 `scratch/` 的草稿暫存資料夾中建立臨時工作檔案時，過去會意外觸發檔案系統的遞迴監聽機制（持續追蹤目錄內所有子檔案變動的背景監控）。這導致許多僅用於中途運算的臨時檔案，全被當成正式成果塞進成品審查面板（審視程式碼產出物的檢視介面）。存檔檢查點更因此留下一堆無關的雜訊紀錄。這次修復將草稿目錄徹底排除在監聽範圍外，讓你的成品面板只列出真正重要的產出。⟦這好似木匠在工作檯旁設置刨花收集桶，刨削過程產生的碎木屑會直接落入桶中，不會被當成精緻成品擺進展示櫃，更不會寫入最終交件清單。⟧
body.en: When an agent drafts scratchpad code or intermediate computations, your workspace panels and version history will no longer be cluttered with temporary files. Previously, when an AI agent wrote temporary working files to the `scratch/` directory, it accidentally triggered recursive filesystem watchers. As a result, intermediate computational files were treated as finished deliverables and flooded into the artifact review panel. Checkpoints were also polluted with noisy, irrelevant entries. This fix thoroughly excludes the scratch directory from filesystem watchers, ensuring your artifact panel only lists truly important outputs. ⟦It is like a carpenter placing a wood shaving collector beside the workbench: discarded wood shavings fall directly into the bin instead of being displayed in the showroom as finished crafts or recorded on the final delivery manifest.⟧

items.original: Fixed temporary working files written to the agent `scratch/` directory triggering recursive filesystem watchers and appearing as noisy entries in the artifact review panel and checkpoints.

title.zh-TW: 全域外掛 MCP 伺服器啟動初始化修復，工具架構放寬相容
title.en: Global plugin MCP servers fix startup initialization, relaxing tool schema validation compatibility

body.zh-TW: 擴充外部工具時，伺服器的啟動連線與工具檢驗現在更加可靠。使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）擴充功能時，過去安裝在全域外掛中的隨附伺服器常在命令列工具啟動時初始化失敗，在外掛啟用或停用時也無法即時同步更新運行狀態。此外，部分第三方工具的輸入規格若未明確寫出 `additionalProperties` 設定，在舊版架構驗證時會被判定不合規而無法呼叫。如今這兩項瑕疵皆已修正，全域外掛隨附的伺服器能如期啟動並隨開關切換狀態，省略該欄位的第三方工具也能正常通過檢驗。⟦有如在攝影棚組裝各廠牌的外接閃光燈，機頂熱靴通電時所有外接燈具會同步就緒且開關即時連動，就算某些副廠配件的說明書少印了一行補充宣告，接上時也能順利通過器材相容測試。⟧
body.en: Expanding external tools is now much more reliable for both server startup and tool schema validation. When using MCP extensions, bundled servers inside globally installed plugins previously failed to initialize at CLI startup and failed to update their running status when plugins were enabled or disabled. Additionally, when third-party tool input schemas omitted the `additionalProperties` setting, legacy schema validation rejected them as non-compliant and blocked tool invocation. Both issues have now been resolved: bundled servers in global plugins initialize as expected while syncing state changes, and third-party tools omitting that field pass validation normally. ⟦It is like setting up multi-brand external flashes in a photography studio: when the camera hot shoe powers on, all external strobes ready up simultaneously with synced switches, and even if a third-party accessory manual misses a supplementary declaration line, it still passes equipment compatibility checks smoothly.⟧

items.original:
Fixed MCP servers bundled inside globally installed plugins failing to initialize at CLI startup or failing to update their running status when plugins are enabled or disabled.
Fixed third-party MCP server tools failing schema validation when their input schemas omit `additionalProperties`.

title.zh-TW: 略過非指令訊息的磁碟設定搜尋，加快代理人作答起步
title.en: Bypassing disk customization discovery for non-command messages speeds up initial agent responses

body.zh-TW: 平常在對話框裡敲入日常問題，你現在能更快看見 AI 開始作答。⟦好比顧客向超商櫃台詢問簡單路況，店員能當場開口回答，不必每次都特地跑回後方庫房翻查厚重的員工交接手冊與促銷規章。⟧過去只要使用者送出一則訊息，即使完全沒有輸入 `/` 斜線開頭的特殊指令，系統依然會在磁碟中進行客製化探索遍歷（在檔案系統逐層搜尋技能與規則設定檔的掃描程序）。這項多餘的搜尋每次都平白耗費時間，拖慢了代理人動手回應的速度。現在系統只在真正呼叫指令時才進行搜尋，有效降低了代理人開始作答前的等待延遲。
body.en: When typing ordinary questions into the chat box, you will now see the AI begin responding much faster. ⟦It is like a customer asking a convenience store clerk for simple directions: the clerk answers immediately without having to run to the backroom storage to dig through thick employee handover handbooks and promotional manuals every single time.⟧ Previously, whenever a user sent a message—even one without any `/` slash command—the system still performed filesystem customization discovery walks. This redundant search wasted time on every turn, adding noticeable delay before the agent began answering. The system now performs disk searches only when a command is actually invoked, effectively reducing response startup latency.

items.original: Fixed unnecessary filesystem customization discovery walks running on every user message even when no slash command is invoked, reducing latency before the agent begins responding.

title.zh-TW: `cli.log` 移除虛假錯誤前綴，背景守護行程日誌不再洗版
title.en: `cli.log` removes spurious error prefixes, clearing log clutter from background daemon output

body.zh-TW: 查看記錄檔或排查系統狀態時，滿螢幕的假警報不再干擾你的判斷。檢視 `cli.log` 記錄檔或執行背景守護程序（daemon，在系統背景運作的常駐服務）的子指令輸出時，終端機與記錄檔現在恢復了乾淨面貌。過去底層程式庫在完成初始化之前，每一行輸出的日誌文字開頭都會被強制加上 `ERROR: logging before google.Init` 這行虛假錯誤字串。這不僅把正常的運作紀錄全染成刺眼的錯誤訊息，造成記錄檔體積虛胖，更嚴重誤導了除錯方向。這次修復調整了初始化的呼叫時機，徹底拔除了這項無意義的錯誤標籤。⟦彷彿出廠檢驗員的手握號碼機卡住，在整批合格產品的外箱上都自動加蓋了「嚴重瑕疵」的紅印，如今校正了印章連動機構，唯有真正故障時才會留下警示。⟧
body.en: When inspecting log files or troubleshooting system status, screens full of false alarms will no longer mislead your investigations. Viewing `cli.log` or running background daemon subcommands now presents clean output in both logs and the terminal. Previously, before the underlying library completed initialization, every logged line was forcefully prefixed with a spurious `ERROR: logging before google.Init` string. This not only painted normal runtime output as alarming error messages and bloated log file sizes, but also severely derailed debugging efforts. This fix adjusts initialization timing, completely eliminating the meaningless error prefix. ⟦It is like a factory inspector's hand-held stamper getting stuck and stamping a red "critical defect" mark on every box of passing products: now that the stamping linkage is recalibrated, warning marks appear only when an actual fault occurs.⟧

items.original: Fixed every log line in `cli.log` and background daemon subcommand output being prefixed with a spurious `ERROR: logging before google.Init` message.

title.zh-TW: Remote Control 修復 macOS 啟動終止與舊腳本殘留，支援付費雲端專案
title.en: Remote Control fixes macOS startup termination and legacy script leftovers, adding paid cloud project support

body.zh-TW: 在不同平台與帳號環境使用 Remote Control 背景服務時，各項運作細節現在更加穩健。⟦這宛如整修廣播電台的自動發射機房，修復了開機即跳電的故障，清空了早期舊控制器殘留的背景連線，付費會員頻道也能正常開啟轉播。⟧在 `macOS` 上由系統服務管理員啟動 `remote-control` 背景服務時，過去常在啟動後不久便異常終止，現在能穩定常駐運行。同時修正了執行 `remote-control start` 與 `remote-control stop` 時，仍會殘留舊版安裝腳本所啟動的背景服務之問題，確保背景服務乾淨交接。此外，若使用者是透過付費 `Google Cloud` 專案取得權限，先前無法開啟 `Remote Control` 設定的問題也已解決，現在能順暢啟用功能。
body.en: Operating the Remote Control background service across different platforms and account environments is now much better behaved. ⟦It is like overhauling an automated broadcast transmitter room: fixing the power trip on startup, purging lingering background connections from early legacy controllers, and enabling smooth broadcasts for paid member channels.⟧ When launched by the system service manager on `macOS`, the `remote-control` background service previously terminated shortly after startup; it now runs stably in the background. Running `remote-control start` and `remote-control stop` no longer leaves background services running from legacy installer scripts, ensuring clean service handoffs. Additionally, for users whose access comes from a paid `Google Cloud` project, the previously unavailable `Remote Control` setting has been fixed, allowing straightforward feature activation.

items.original: Fixed the macOS `remote-control` background service terminating shortly after startup when launched by the system service manager, `remote-control start` and `remote-control stop` leaving legacy installer-script background services running, and the Remote Control setting being unavailable when your access comes from a paid Google Cloud project.

title.zh-TW: 舊版對話支援相容載入，恢復歷史紀錄不再因未知步驟中斷
title.en: Legacy conversations gain backward-compatible loading, preventing resume failures on unknown steps

body.zh-TW: 想接續幾天前或更新前留下的對話記錄時，對話歷程不再因為格式不認得而拒絕載入。以前使用恢復對話功能時，若該筆歷史紀錄是在較早版本中建立，系統常因無法辨識記錄檔裡的舊版步驟格式，而跳出 `unknown step type` 錯誤中斷載入，導致整段對話完全無法開啟。現在載入解析器強化了對舊格式的向下相容能力，即使對話中包含過去定義的步驟型別，也能順利讀取並完整還原對話現場。⟦好似翻開圖書館館藏的早期手稿，即便內頁蓋著前幾代管理員留下的舊版分類戳章，新版讀取機也能順暢辨識，不再因為印章代碼停產就拒絕翻頁。⟧
body.en: When picking up past conversations from days ago or before an update, your chat history will no longer fail to load due to unrecognized formats. Previously, when resuming a conversation created in an older version, the system often failed with an `unknown step type` error because it could not recognize legacy step formats in the log, making the entire conversation unopenable. The loader parser now features improved backward compatibility for older formats, smoothly parsing legacy step types and fully restoring the conversation session. ⟦It is like opening an early archival manuscript in a library: even if internal pages bear obsolete classification stamps from earlier generations of curators, the new scanner recognizes them smoothly instead of refusing to turn the page over discontinued stamp codes.⟧

items.original: Fixed older conversations failing to load with an `unknown step type` error when resumed.

title.zh-TW: 遇到 503 暫時錯誤自動長重試，工作階段不中斷
title.en: Automatic extended retries on temporary 503 errors keep sessions uninterrupted

body.zh-TW: 你正請 AI 執行冗長的多步驟任務，最怕遇到遠端模型伺服器短暫壅塞。⟦好似在熱門麵包店結帳時遇到刷卡機短暫斷線，店員不會立刻退回商品並將你請出店門，而是請你稍待片刻後再次感應，直到連線恢復。⟧ 以前只要碰上 `503 Unavailable` 這類短暫的模型介面錯誤，整個正在進行的工作階段（session，從啟動到結束的一整段對話歷程）就會被迫終止。現在代理人遇到這類暫時狀況，會透過指數退避（重試等待時間隨失敗次數拉長的做法）大幅延長重試期。即使服務發生短暫波動，也不會隨意中斷你的工作階段。
body.en: When asking AI to perform long multi-step tasks, the biggest worry is hitting brief congestion on remote model servers. ⟦Much like a card reader briefly disconnecting at a busy bakery checkout, where the clerk does not immediately return your items and show you out the door, but asks you to wait a moment and tap again until the connection recovers.⟧ Previously, whenever encountering a transient model API error like `503 Unavailable`, the entire ongoing session was forced to terminate. Now, when encountering such temporary situations, the agent significantly extends the retry period using exponential backoff (waiting longer between retries as failed attempts increase). Even during brief service fluctuations, your session will no longer be casually interrupted.

items.original: Improved resilience to transient model API errors: the agent now retries errors such as `503 Unavailable` for much longer with exponential backoff, so a brief service hiccup no longer aborts your session.

title.zh-TW: 本機憑證快讀登入身分，切換帳號清空企業舊資料
title.en: Local credentials speed up sign-in identity checks and account switching clears stale business data

body.zh-TW: 每次啟動工具或切換帳號，現在都能迅速就緒。以前每次開啟命令列或在瀏覽器完成授權，都要先送出一趟網路請求確認身分；若是查詢遇到問題，整個登入程序就會卡住中斷，啟動時顯示的方案等級也常常閃爍消失。現在改為直接從儲存的憑證（存放在本機的登入身分證明）讀取資料，查詢失敗不再阻礙登入完成，畫面上的方案等級更維持穩定顯示。若是你剛從選定專案的企業帳號切換至個人帳號，舊的企業專案與授權細節現在會被徹底清除，不再因為殘留過期資料而跳出專案存取錯誤。⟦這好比拿出皮夾裡已蓋章的會員卡直接通關，驗票員不必每次都打電話回總部查驗，換成一般訪客卡時也會順手收回貴賓通行證，不再拿舊通行條擋住入口。⟧
body.en: Launching the tool or switching accounts is now ready promptly every time. Previously, opening the CLI or completing browser authorization required sending a network request to verify your identity; if the lookup ran into issues, the entire sign-in process would freeze and halt, and the plan tier shown at startup often flickered and disappeared. Now, data is read directly from stored credentials (login identity proofs stored locally), so lookup failures no longer block sign-in completion, and the on-screen plan tier remains stably displayed. If you switch from a business account with a selected project to a personal account, old business project and license details are now thoroughly cleared, preventing project access errors caused by leftover stale data. ⟦This is like showing a stamped membership card directly from your wallet at the gate without ticket staff calling headquarters every time, and handing over a regular visitor pass while returning the VIP badge so outdated passes will not block the entrance.⟧

items.original:
Improved sign-in and startup speed by reading your signed-in identity from the stored credential instead of making a network request on every launch and after browser consent; a failed identity lookup no longer prevents sign-in from completing, and the displayed plan tier no longer briefly disappears during startup.
Fixed sign-in failing with a project access error after switching from a business account with a selected project to a personal account; stale business project and license details are now fully cleared on personal sign-in.

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式自動化更順暢，及時退出且日誌回報清晰
title.en: Smoother headless automation with prompt exits and clear error reporting

body.zh-TW: 將指令串進自動化排程時，最講求乾淨俐落與明確回報。⟦宛如快遞物流車隊的夜間集運，貨件裝車完畢就立即發車，沿途留下明確標籤與簽收單，不因無人簽名而原地乾等。⟧ 啟用無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗的非互動執行模式）搭配 `-p` 旗標時，現在送達最終答案便會迅速退出。背景任務與排程計時器受 `--print-timeout` 限制等待結束，但開發伺服器等常駐守護工作會持續運行而不被強制中止。每輪執行省下多達 200 ms 閒置延遲，並跳過生成無人查看的對話標題。遇到無人互動的實作計畫審查時會自動通過。若 `--print-timeout` 中途逾時，會回傳既有輸出並在 stderr 附帶警告成功退出，手動按 Ctrl+C 中斷則維持非零退出碼。嚴重錯誤在 stderr 加上穩定的 `error:` 標記，提示潛在截斷並解釋先前靜默結束的原因。
body.en: Chaining commands into automated workflows demands clean execution and explicit feedback. ⟦Much like a logistics delivery fleet consolidating cargo overnight, departing immediately once loading is complete and leaving clear labels and receipts along the way without idling on-site because no one is there to sign.⟧ When running in headless mode with the `-p` flag, the CLI now exits promptly once the final answer is delivered. Running background tasks and scheduled timers are waited on subject to `--print-timeout`, while persistent daemon tasks like development servers continue running without being forcefully terminated. Each turn cuts up to 200 ms of idle latency and skips generating conversation titles that nobody would see. Non-interactive implementation plan reviews now pass automatically. If `--print-timeout` expires mid-turn, it returns the partial output and exits successfully with a warning on stderr, while manual Ctrl+C interrupts still exit with a non-zero code. Fatal errors add a stable `error:` marker on stderr, noting potential truncation and explaining why previous runs ended silently.

items.original:
Improved headless (`-p`) runs to exit promptly once the final answer is delivered: the CLI waits for running background tasks and scheduled timers to finish, bound by `--print-timeout`, and leaves daemon background tasks such as dev servers running instead of terminating them.
Improved failure reporting in headless (`-p`) runs: fatal errors now appear on stderr with a stable `error:` marker, a note is printed when the response may be truncated, and runs that previously ended silently with no output now explain why.
Improved headless (`-p`) turnaround by cutting up to 200 ms of idle latency per turn and skipping the model call that generated a conversation title no one would see.
Changed what happens when `--print-timeout` expires mid-turn: the CLI now returns the partial output it has and exits successfully with a warning on stderr, instead of failing with a timeout error; interrupts such as Ctrl+C still exit non-zero.
Fixed headless (`-p`) runs stalling forever on implementation-plan approval that no one could give; non-interactive runs now proceed through plan review automatically.

title.zh-TW: 讀取網址改為預先詢問，工具審查提示說清緣由
title.en: URL fetching asks for permission first and tool approval prompts explain reasons clearly

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 代勞查資料或動用本機工具時，安全把關更加清晰。抓取網址的預設權限從一律允許改為先問過你，除非預先授權，否則讀取網址前都會請求同意。工具審核提示也迎來翻新，明確點出審核項目——例如詢問 `Run this command?`、`Allow access to this URL?` 還是 `Allow calling this tool?`。編輯命令的快捷鍵僅在審核命令時提供，避免介面混淆。當審核原因不明顯時，下方會附上一行 `Reason:` 說明緣由，例如觸發了掛鉤（hook，在特定事件發生時觸發的攔截小程式）標記，或是涉及其他專案的檔案。⟦這彷彿在大門加裝智慧訪視對講機，外人想進門必須先按鈴通報，螢幕上清楚顯示對方的來意與身分，還會註記警衛攔檢的理由，不再讓人盲目按下開門鈕。⟧
body.en: Security guardrails are much clearer when having AI fetch data or invoke local tools. The default permission for fetching URLs has changed from always allowed to asking first, requesting approval before reading a URL unless pre-authorized. Tool approval prompts have also been revamped to specify exactly what is being approved—such as asking `Run this command?`, `Allow access to this URL?`, or `Allow calling this tool?`. The shortcut for editing commands is only offered when approving a command, preventing interface confusion. When the reason for approval is not obvious, a `Reason:` line is attached below explaining why, such as a hook flagging the action or a file belonging to a different project. ⟦This is like installing a smart intercom at the front door: visitors must ring first, the screen clearly displays their identity and purpose, and notes any guard inspection reasons so you never press the door release blindly.⟧

items.original:
Improved tool approval prompts to say exactly what you are approving — for example `Run this command?`, `Allow access to this URL?`, or `Allow calling this tool?` — with the command-editing shortcut offered only when a command is being approved, and a `Reason:` line explaining why approval is being requested when it is not obvious, such as a hook flagging the action or a file belonging to a different project.
Changed the default permission for fetching URLs from always allowed to asking first, so the agent now requests approval before reading a URL unless you have granted access.

title.zh-TW: 模型名稱轉換留存日誌，稽核軌跡隨時可查
title.en: Model name resolutions are logged for traceable audit trails

body.zh-TW: 在終端機指定模型名稱時，背後的實際流向現在一清二楚。⟦如同在藥局憑處方箋領藥，當藥劑師因原廠藥缺貨或劑型調整而替換成同成分學名藥時，收據與藥袋上都會清楚加註替換紀錄與變更原因。⟧ 命令列工具增強了模型選擇的稽核能力。當你輸入的模型名稱在後台被解析對應到另一款模型時，日誌都會詳實記錄具體轉換過程。無論是輸入別名對應到正式名稱、透過 `--effort` 旗標切換到不同推理程度的變體，或是先前儲存的舊模型因下架廢棄而被替換，日誌中都有跡可循。這讓你不必猜測背後到底跑的是哪一個版本，隨時都能追溯實際運行的模型。
body.en: When specifying model names in the terminal, the actual underlying resolution is now crystal clear. ⟦Much like filling a prescription at a pharmacy where an out-of-stock brand-name drug is substituted with an equivalent generic, with the replacement record and rationale clearly noted on the receipt and label.⟧ The CLI tool has enhanced its auditability for model selection. Whenever a model name you specify resolves behind the scenes to a different model, the logs faithfully record the specific conversion process. Whether resolving an alias to an official name, switching to a different reasoning variant via the `--effort` flag, or replacing a deprecated saved model, everything leaves a clear trail in the logs. This removes any guesswork about which version is running behind the scenes, allowing you to trace the active model at any time.

items.original: Improved model selection auditability: the CLI log now records whenever a model name you specify resolves to a different model, such as alias resolution, `--effort` variant selection, or replacement of a deprecated saved model.

title.zh-TW: 外掛重裝乾淨覆蓋目錄，MCP 相對路徑基準修正
title.en: Plugin reinstalls cleanly replace directories and MCP relative paths resolve accurately

body.zh-TW: 管理擴充套件與隨附工具時，現在不再留下惱人的殘存檔案。過去重新安裝外掛時，來源端已經刪除的舊檔案仍會留在目錄裡；現在安裝會精確替換整個外掛管理目錄，且若嘗試從外掛自身的已安裝目錄再次執行安裝，會被直接拒絕以防目錄損壞。解除安裝外掛後，也不會在 `config.json` 中留下殘餘的啟用或停用項目。同時，外掛所定義的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器若使用相對路徑或未指定工作目錄，先前會依錯誤位置解析；現在一律以該外掛本身的目錄為基準進行解析，確保隨附腳本正常運行。⟦恰似替相機更換擴充鏡頭套組，換上新套件時會徹底移走舊鏡片，拆除時順便清除控制選單裡的舊按鍵，套組內的專用濾鏡也一律以該鏡頭接環為基準精準卡位。⟧
body.en: Managing plugins and bundled tools no longer leaves annoying leftover files behind. Previously, reinstalling a plugin left old files that were already deleted from the source inside the directory; now, installation replaces the managed plugin directory exactly, and attempting to install from the plugin's own installed directory is directly rejected to prevent corruption. Uninstalling a plugin also no longer leaves leftover enabled or disabled entries in `config.json`. Meanwhile, if MCP servers defined by plugins use relative paths or leave the working directory unset, they previously resolved against the wrong location; they now consistently resolve against the plugin's own directory, ensuring bundled scripts run properly. ⟦Just like swapping a camera lens kit: mounting a new set completely removes old glass, detaching it cleans up stale button mappings from the control menu, and dedicated kit filters align accurately against the lens mount.⟧

items.original:
Fixed plugin reinstalls keeping files that had been deleted from the source: installing a plugin now replaces its managed directory exactly, installing a plugin from its own installed directory is refused instead of corrupting it, and uninstalling a plugin no longer leaves its enabled/disabled entry behind in `config.json`.
Fixed MCP servers defined by plugins resolving relative or unset working directories against the wrong location; they now resolve against the plugin's own directory so plugin-bundled scripts run correctly.

title.zh-TW: 子代理啟動不再遺漏工具，任務結束即刻解鎖佇列
title.en: Subagents reliably discover tools at startup and release queued messages upon completion

body.zh-TW: 多工派發子代理處理複雜任務時，工具抓取與狀態切換更加可靠。先前在系統啟動時存在競爭問題，如果外部工具伺服器仍在初始化，子代理往往會撲空。現在 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器會確保初始化完成，讓子代理隨時能找到工具。此外，特別是在超長對話中，子代理在執行完畢後有時會卡在運行狀態；這不僅造成狀態誤判，還會讓原本排隊等候閒置時發送的訊息一路卡住，非得重啟程式才能送出。如今這兩項瑕疵都已修復，子代理在任務結束後會正確切換狀態並如期交付排隊訊息。⟦有如工廠調派實習助理進場作業，開工前一定等儀器暖機完畢才放行領取工具，任務交代完畢也會立即回報交班，不再假裝忙碌而讓後續排隊的派工單全部卡死在收發室。⟧
body.en: Dispatching subagents for complex multi-tasking now offers more reliable tool discovery and state transitions. Previously, a startup race condition meant subagents could fail to find tools if external tool servers were still initializing. Now, MCP servers ensure initialization finishes so subagents can always find their tools. Additionally, especially in very large conversations, subagents sometimes appeared stuck in a running state after finishing; this caused incorrect status reporting and left messages queued for idle delivery stuck until restarting the application. Both issues are now resolved, so subagents properly transition their state and deliver queued messages on schedule once tasks finish. ⟦Like assigning an intern assistant on the factory floor: they are only sent to fetch tools after equipment warms up, and they report shift handovers immediately upon finishing tasks rather than pretending to stay busy and stalling dispatch orders in the mailroom.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a startup race where subagents could fail to find tools from MCP servers that were still initializing.
Fixed subagents sometimes appearing stuck in a running state after they had finished — especially in very large conversations — which also left queued when-idle messages undelivered until restart.

title.zh-TW: 終端機命令及時釋放內部狀態，長工作階段記憶體大降
title.en: Terminal commands release internal state promptly to cut memory usage in long sessions

body.zh-TW: 長時間在同一個工作階段中連續敲入指令，不再面臨記憶體越吃越腫的窘境。以前工具內部存在記憶體流失（程式結束運算後未及時釋放資源的現象）缺陷。只要在終端機中執行過任何命令，該命令的內部狀態就會被保留在記憶體中，直到整個工作階段（session，從啟動到關閉的完整使用過程）結束為止。這導致使用者若是開啟長期會話並執行大量指令，記憶體用量就會一路飆升。這次修復徹底清除了執行完畢後的殘留狀態，讓執行許多指令的長工作階段大幅降低記憶體消耗。⟦就像廚房料理台每做完一道菜就立即隨手擦拭乾淨，不再將用過的空盤與鍋具一路堆到打烊，就算連續出餐一整天，工作檯面也始終保持輕盈俐落。⟧
body.en: Running continuous commands in the same session no longer leads to runaway memory bloat. Previously, the tool suffered from a memory leak where every executed terminal command retained its internal state in memory for the rest of the session. As a result, running many commands in extended sessions caused memory usage to surge continuously. This fix thoroughly clears residual state once commands finish, significantly reducing memory consumption in long sessions that run many commands. ⟦Much like wiping down a kitchen countertop immediately after each dish instead of piling up used plates and pots until closing time, keeping the workspace neat and uncluttered even during a full day of service.⟧

items.original: Fixed a memory leak where every finished terminal command kept internal state alive for the rest of the session; long sessions that run many commands now use significantly less memory.

title.zh-TW: `/model` 支援單次提問切換，輸入提示與啟動選單全面修正
title.en: `/model` Supports Single-Prompt Model Switching with Comprehensive Fixes to Input Hints and Startup Menus

body.zh-TW: 對話進行到一半想換個模型問一句話，現在不必更改整體設定。⟦像向主治醫師看診時，中途請隔壁專科專家進診間單獨看一張片子，問完立即回到主治醫師，不必重新辦理轉院手續。⟧新指令 `/model <name> <prompt>` 讓你用另一個模型跑單次提問，結束後工作階段（你與 AI 進行對話的一段連線）自動切回原本模型，完全不影響已儲存的預設值。寫完程式想打 `/model gemini-3.8-flash 檢查資安漏洞` 諮詢其他觀點，這正是使用時機。此外，輸入 `/model` 時會即時浮現 `[model]` 參數提示，不開求助說明也能知道用法。若工作階段已在該模型，指令改為回報 `Model already set to <name>` 而非誤報切換。在工作階段啟動完成前輸入不帶參數的 `/model`，現在也會正常開啟模型挑選器。
body.en: You no longer need to change your global settings when you want to switch models for a single question mid-conversation. ⟦It is like consulting your primary physician and having a specialist step into the examination room just to review a single scan, immediately returning to your primary physician once done without undergoing hospital transfer procedures.⟧ The new `/model <name> <prompt>` command lets you run a single prompt on another model, automatically returning the session to its original model afterward without affecting your saved defaults. If you finish writing code and want to run `/model gemini-3.8-flash check for security vulnerabilities` to consult another perspective, this is the exact use case. In addition, typing `/model` now displays a real-time `[model]` argument hint so you know how to use it without opening help. If the session is already using that model, the command now reports `Model already set to <name>` instead of falsely reporting a switch. Running `/model` without arguments before the session finishes starting up also now properly opens the model picker.

items.original:
Added `/model <name> <prompt>`, which runs a single prompt on another model and then returns the session to the model it was using, so you can consult a different model mid-conversation without disturbing your saved default.
Improved `/model` to show a `[model]` argument hint as you type, so the command's arguments are discoverable without opening help.
Changed `/model <name>` to report `Model already set to <name>` when the session is already using that model, instead of reporting a switch that did not happen.
Fixed `/model` with no argument doing nothing when run before the session had finished starting up, so it now opens the model picker.

title.zh-TW: Markdown 自訂代理支援 `agents` 清單，直接宣告相依子代理路徑
title.en: Custom Markdown Agents Support `agents` List to Directly Declare Dependent Subagent Paths

body.zh-TW:
替專案設計多代理協作時，自訂代理現在能直接宣告自己專屬的下層幫手。在定義代理的 Markdown 檔案開頭，檔案標頭（frontmatter，用三條橫線包夾的設定區塊）新增了 `agents` 清單。你可以直接列出該代理依賴的各個子代理，並完全比照 `skills` 技能的定位方式，自由使用工作區相對路徑、絕對路徑或代理相對路徑：

```
---
agents:
  - ./researcher.md       # 代理相對路徑
  - subagents/verifier.md # 工作區相對路徑
  - /global/audit.md      # 絕對路徑
---
```

當你撰寫一份資安稽核代理，希望它自動叫出專門查閱程式碼的輔助幫手，只要在定義檔開頭寫好這份清單，系統就會精準載入依賴項目。⟦好比主廚在宴席菜單頂端註明各道菜餚專屬的備料助手與冷盤學徒，後廚依名冊在開工前配齊人手，不必等客人入座後才手忙腳亂到處調派支援。⟧
body.en:
When designing multi-agent collaboration for a project, custom agents can now directly declare their own subordinate helpers. The Markdown frontmatter at the beginning of an agent definition file has added an `agents` list. You can directly list the subagents this agent depends on, using workspace-relative paths, absolute paths, or agent-relative paths just like `skills`:

```
---
agents:
  - ./researcher.md       # Agent-relative path
  - subagents/verifier.md # Workspace-relative path
  - /global/audit.md      # Absolute path
---
```

When creating a security audit agent that needs to automatically invoke a dedicated code inspection helper, simply declaring this list at the top of the definition file ensures the system accurately loads the dependencies. ⟦Like a head chef listing dedicated prep assistants and cold-dish apprentices at the top of a banquet menu so the kitchen can staff up before work begins, rather than scrambling to dispatch helpers after guests are seated.⟧

items.original: Added an `agents` list to custom agent Markdown frontmatter, letting an agent declare the subagents it depends on using the same workspace-relative, absolute, and agent-relative path rules as `skills`.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列與視窗標題腳本新增 `conversation_title`，即時同步對話重新命名
title.en: Status Line and Window Title Scripts Add `conversation_title` to Synchronize Renamed Conversations in Real Time

body.zh-TW:
想要在螢幕邊界隨時掌握當前對話，自訂腳本現在能取得更豐富的資訊。⟦如同會議室門口掛著的數位名牌，只要發起人更改專案名稱，螢幕隨即同步換上新標題，讓走進門的人一目了然。⟧傳遞給自訂狀態列（終端機最底下的即時資訊列）與視窗標題腳本的 JSON 酬載中，新增了 `conversation_title` 欄位。你的腳本可以直接讀取該欄位來顯示當前進行中的對話名稱，即使中途為對話重新命名，介面也能立即跟進最新標題，不再停留在舊名稱或預設代號：

```
{
  "conversation_title": "重構登入模組"
}
```

當你同時開啟多個終端機視窗處理不同專案，只要腳本讀取這個新欄位，就能清楚辨認每個視窗正在進行的任務主題。
body.en:
Custom scripts can now retrieve richer information to help you track active conversations at the screen edge at any time. ⟦Like a digital nameplate outside a conference room that instantly updates when the organizer renames the project, giving anyone walking in immediate clarity.⟧ The JSON payload passed to custom status line and window title scripts now includes a `conversation_title` field. Your scripts can directly read this field to display the active conversation's name, picking up renames immediately rather than staying stuck on old names or default identifiers:

```
{
  "conversation_title": "Refactor login module"
}
```

When running multiple terminal windows across different projects, having your script read this new field makes it easy to identify the task topic in each window.

items.original: Added a `conversation_title` field to the JSON payload passed to custom status line and window title scripts, so they can show the active conversation's name and pick up renames immediately.

title.zh-TW: 無頭與列印模式 `-p` 執行加固，未授權動作明確列出且紀錄完整落盤
title.en: Hardened Execution for Headless and Print Mode `-p`: Unauthorized Actions Explicitly Listed and Records Flushed to Disk

body.zh-TW: 把 AI 放入自動化排程背景執行，最怕工具被拒絕時毫無動靜、或者紀錄沒寫完就中途斷線。⟦宛如派出全自動無人採樣車，遇到未經授權的管制區域時不再裝作沒事直接略過，而是在日誌中白紙黑字寫明被拒絕的地點，且返航時一定等所有檢測數據完整寫入隨身碟才關閉電源。⟧以 `-p` 參數跑 headless（無頭模式，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式）時，過去系統若遇到未獲授權的工具動作，會默默跳過不執行；現在程式結束時會明確列出被拒絕的動作名稱，並在 JSON 輸出中標記為 `denied_actions`。此外，列印模式以前在工作階段尚未完成關閉前就過早退出，容易導致末尾的對話歷史紀錄還沒寫入磁碟就被丟棄；現在會確實等待工作階段完整落盤後才退出。
body.en: When running AI in background automated schedules, the worst issues are silent tool rejections or dropped records due to premature disconnections. ⟦Like an autonomous sampling rover that, when encountering an unauthorized restricted zone, no longer skips past it silently but clearly logs the refused location in writing, and always waits for all telemetry to flush to storage before powering off on its return.⟧ When running headless with `-p`, the system previously skipped unauthorized tool actions silently; it now ends with a notice naming the refused actions and reports them as `denied_actions` in the JSON output. In addition, print mode previously exited before the session finished shutting down, which could drop trailing conversation history before it reached disk; it now properly waits for the session to finish writing to disk before exiting.

items.original:
Fixed headless runs with `-p` silently skipping tool actions they were not permitted to take, which now end with a notice naming the refused actions and report them as `denied_actions` in the JSON output.
Fixed print mode (`-p`) exiting before the session finished shutting down, which could drop the run's trailing conversation history before it reached disk.

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具呼叫嚴格核對規格，虛構參數主動拒絕並修正
title.en: MCP Tool Calls Strictly Validate Schemas, Actively Rejecting and Correcting Invented Parameters

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 連接外部伺服器執行專屬工具，傳入參數的檢驗標準現在變得更加嚴密。過去呼叫 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器時，如果 AI 自行虛構了該伺服器規格架構中從未宣告過的額外參數，舊版系統往往會默默丟棄這些多餘參數而不提示，導致呼叫行為偏離預期。現在底層驗證機制已修正，遇到規格外的虛構參數會主動予以拒絕並要求修正，確保每次工具呼叫都嚴格符合定義。⟦這就像去銀行臨櫃填寫匯款單，如果填表人自作主張在空白處多勾選了規格從未印製的自創項目，櫃員不會裝作沒看見直接劃掉，而是會當場退單並指引你填寫合規欄位。⟧
body.en: Validation standards for passing arguments have become much stricter when connecting AI to external servers for dedicated tools. When calling MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers in the past, if the AI invented extra arguments never declared in the server's schema, the system often silently dropped them without notice, causing unexpected behavior. The underlying validation mechanism is now fixed to actively reject and correct invented parameters outside the schema, ensuring every tool call strictly matches definitions. ⟦Like filling out a bank transfer slip where, if the applicant checks custom options never printed on the form, the teller will not silently cross them out, but will reject the slip on the spot and guide you to fill out valid fields.⟧

items.original: Fixed tool calls to MCP servers accepting arguments the server's own schema never declared, so an invented parameter is now rejected and corrected instead of being silently dropped.

title.zh-TW: 設定面板詳述輸出詳細度，初始引導畫面按鍵提示全面標準化
title.en: Settings Panel Details Verbosity Levels, and Onboarding Key Hints Are Fully Standardized

body.zh-TW: 在終端機調整設定或初次登入時，畫面引導變得更加貼合你的使用習慣。⟦在科技展廳的觸控機台前瀏覽時，每當手勢移到不同選項，旁邊的動態看板就會詳細解釋功能差異，且按鈕背光會自動配合展廳色調，遇到單一通道時更會主動收起多餘的方向提示。⟧開啟 `/settings` 設定面板時，游標移到各個 Verbosity 詳細度選項上，畫面會即時展開說明文字。它會詳細描述工具呼叫、終端指令與思考推導是完整展開顯示，還是濃縮進 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）計量表中。此外，帳號登入與 Google Cloud 設定引導畫面全面改用命令列標準樣式的按鍵提示，能完全跟隨你的終端配色與自訂鍵位綁定，當畫面上只有單一選項可選時，系統也會主動隱藏多餘的方向導覽提示。
body.en: On-screen guidance fits your habits much better when tweaking settings in the terminal or logging in for the first time. ⟦Like browsing a touchscreen kiosk in a tech showroom where highlighting different options prompts a dynamic billboard to explain functional differences, button backlights adapt to showroom colors, and navigation arrows hide when only a single path exists.⟧ When opening the `/settings` panel, highlighting each Verbosity option now expands explanatory text in real time. It describes in detail whether tool calls, terminal commands, and thoughts are shown in full or collapsed into a token metrics table. In addition, sign-in and Google Cloud setup screens now use standard styled CLI key hints that follow your terminal color scheme and custom keybindings, dropping navigation hints when only one option is available.

items.original:
Improved the `/settings` panel so each Verbosity option explains itself as you highlight it, describing whether tool calls, commands, and thoughts are shown in full or collapsed into a token metrics table.
Improved the sign-in and Google Cloud setup screens to use the CLI's standard styled key hints, which follow your color scheme and keybindings and drop the navigation hint when only one option is available.

title.zh-TW: Vim 常規模式解開 `?` 按鍵衝突，行內搜尋與替換指令順暢運作
title.en: Vim Normal Mode Resolves `?` Key Conflict, Restoring Inline Search and Replace Operators

body.zh-TW: 習慣在終端機開啟 Vim 鍵位的工程師，現在於輸入列進行行內定位時不再誤觸彈出視窗。過去在 Vim Normal mode（Vim 編輯器的常規命令模式）下，只要輸入框內已經包含文字，按下 `?` 鍵就會錯誤地觸發快速鍵面板跳出，導致 `f?`、`t?` 以及 `df?` 等字元搜尋與替換操作符全面失靈。現在這項按鍵攔截問題已經修復，當輸入列已有文字時，這些搜尋與替換指令都能順暢運作；只有在輸入列完全空白的待機狀態下，按下 `?` 才會如常開啟快速鍵說明。⟦彷彿在打字機上編修文件，當滾筒夾著稿紙且正在編輯時，按下特殊標點會精確執行行內字元搜尋、跳位與替換，只有在完全抽空稿紙的待機狀態下，同一個按鍵才會化身為叫出操作手冊的呼叫鈴。⟧
body.en: Engineers used to Vim keybindings in the terminal will no longer accidentally trigger popup panels during inline navigation in the prompt. Previously in Vim Normal mode, pressing `?` while the prompt already contained text incorrectly opened the shortcuts panel, breaking character-search and replace operators such as `f?`, `t?`, and `df?`. This key intercept issue is now fixed so that search and replace commands work smoothly when the prompt has text; pressing `?` only opens shortcut help when the prompt is completely empty. ⟦Like editing on a typewriter where pressing a punctuation key performs precise inline character search, jumping, and replacement while paper is loaded, and only acts as a service bell summoning the manual when the roller is completely empty.⟧

items.original: Fixed `?` in Vim Normal mode opening the shortcuts panel while the prompt already contained text, so character-search and replace operators such as `f?`, `t?`, and `df?` work; `?` still opens shortcuts on an empty prompt.

title.zh-TW: 已授權存取工作區外檔案時，讀寫跨對話產物不再跳多餘確認
title.en: Reading and Writing Cross-Conversation Artifacts No Longer Prompts for Redundant Approval When Workspace Access Is Granted

body.zh-TW: 跨對話調閱過往產出的分析文件，不必再被重複彈出的確認視窗打斷工作節奏。當使用者在對話中已經明確核准代理存取工作區以外的檔案路徑，後續若代理需要讀取或寫入另一段對話所產生的產物（artifact，獨立生成的各類文件或程式碼）檔案，過去系統仍會反覆彈出多餘的授權詢問對話框，中斷連續操作；現在這項重複提示已被徹底修復，只要先前已放行外部路徑，代理就能順暢讀寫其他對話的產物。⟦入住全包式度假村，手腕上已經配戴通行全區的識別手環，走進隔壁活動中心借閱其他房客留下的共享桌遊，櫃檯就不該要求你再次出示護照並重複簽名。⟧
body.en: Retrieving past analysis documents across conversations no longer interrupts your workflow with repeated confirmation popups. Once you explicitly allow an agent access to file paths outside your workspace, the system previously still prompted repeatedly for approval whenever the agent read or wrote artifact files created by another conversation; this redundant prompt is now fixed so the agent smoothly accesses artifacts from other conversations once external paths have been permitted. ⟦Like staying at an all-inclusive resort where wearing an all-access wristband means the front desk should not ask for your passport and signature again when you borrow board games from the recreation center next door.⟧

items.original: Fixed a redundant approval prompt when the agent reads or writes another conversation's artifact files after you have already allowed access to files outside your workspace.

title.zh-TW: Grok 登上用量報表與互動儀表板，四張對照表同步補齊
title.en: Grok arrives in usage reports and the interactive dashboard with four synchronized lookup tables

body.zh-TW: 平時習慣呼叫 Grok 協作的開發者，現在執行 `usage report` 或切換至互動儀表板時，終於能將它的用量一併納入統計。⟦這好比商場服務台早早掛出新專櫃的會員卡，樓層指南與各收銀機名冊卻全漏記，消費者看全館總表時始終找不到它；把各處對照表補齊後才完整歸隊。⟧先前 macOS 選單列雖有 Grok 的額度卡，讀取器 `loaders/grok_loader.py` 也能吐出逐次呼叫的 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）明細，但轉接層缺少 `adapters/grok.py`，導致終端機報表與儀表板對它視而不見。這次除了補上轉接器，也同步了四張必須一致的對照表：註冊表的偵測清單、指令列與報表產生器的 `AGENT_LOADERS`，以及表格介面的 `AGENT_SHORT` 與 `AGENT_LABEL`。
body.en: Developers who regularly collaborate with Grok can now finally include its usage in statistics when running `usage report` or switching to the interactive dashboard. ⟦This is like a mall information desk displaying membership cards for a new boutique while the floor directory and register rosters omit it entirely, leaving shoppers unable to find it on the mall-wide directory until lookup tables everywhere are completed.⟧ While the macOS menu bar previously had a Grok quota card and the loader `loaders/grok_loader.py` could produce per-call token details, the adapter layer lacked `adapters/grok.py`, leaving the terminal report and dashboard blind to it. In addition to adding the adapter, this update synchronizes the four lookup tables that must agree: the registry's detector list, `AGENT_LOADERS` in the CLI and report generator, and `AGENT_SHORT` and `AGENT_LABEL` in the table UI.

items.original: **Grok now appears in the report and the interactive dashboard.** The menu bar has carried a Grok quota card for a while and `loaders/grok_loader.py` could already produce per-call token detail, but there was no `adapters/grok.py`, so both `usage report` and the dashboard were blind to it. The adapter was added along with the four lookup tables that have to agree: the registry's detector list, the `AGENT_LOADERS` maps in `usage_cli` and `reporter`, and `AGENT_SHORT` / `AGENT_LABEL` in `ui/tables`.

title.zh-TW: 報表細分四類 token 並顯示快取命中率，釐清真實消耗
title.en: Reports split tokens into four categories and display cache hit rates to clarify real consumption

body.zh-TW: 想掌握 AI 的實際消耗，過去報表頂部的「燒掉 Tokens」只把四種不同性質的數字加總成單一數值，根本看不出關鍵細節。⟦這好比水電帳單只印出一筆總度數，卻把洗澡水、澆花水與管線循環水全混在一起，讓人無法判斷用水習慣是否健康。⟧本機測試某期 2,565,454,499 個 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）裡，高達 93.8% 是讀取快取的舊資料。快取就是把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接取用；模型真正生成的輸出只佔 0.7%，單看總額毫無意義。現在報表正式拆分為輸入、快取寫入、快取讀取與輸出四類，並計算各工具的快取命中率。算式以快取讀取除以三種輸入脈絡總額，排除掉生成出的輸出。高命中率代表舊脈絡以約十分之一的單價重複取用，五種語言的文案也明確引導此數值象徵體質良好而非無效重複。底層一直都記錄著這四個欄位，先前僅是報表彙整時丟棄，因此不必清理快取或升級資料格式。
body.en: To understand actual AI consumption, the headline "tokens burned" at the top of previous reports summed four distinct numbers into a single total, obscuring key details. ⟦This is like a water bill that only prints a single total usage while lumping shower water, garden water, and recirculated pipe water together, making it impossible to judge whether consumption habits are healthy.⟧ In local testing across a period of 2,565,454,499 tokens, as much as 93.8% was cache read while only 0.7% was output the model actually generated, rendering the raw total meaningless. The report now formally breaks down usage into input, cache write, cache read, and output, while calculating cache hit rates for each tool. The formula divides cache read by the sum of the three input contexts, excluding the generated output. A high hit rate indicates that old context is reused at roughly one-tenth the unit price, and the copy across all five languages explicitly frames this metric as a sign of healthy efficiency rather than wasteful repetition. The underlying layer has always recorded all four fields and previous versions merely discarded them during report aggregation, so no cache clearing or data format upgrade is required.

items.original: **The report breaks tokens into four kinds and shows each tool's cache hit rate.** The headline "tokens burned" was one number summing four different things; locally, 93.8% of a 2,565,454,499-token period was `cache_read` and only 0.7% was output the model actually generated, so the total said nothing. `UsageEntry` has always carried all four fields and `loaders/disk_cache_common.py` serialized all four — `reporter` was dropping them when it built the summary, so no cache and no schema version had to change. Cache hit rate is `cache_read / (input + cache_creation + cache_read)`; output is excluded because it is generated, not sent in. A high rate is the healthy end — old context reused at roughly a tenth of the price instead of re-sent at full rate — and the copy in all five languages is written to keep it from being read as "most of my tokens are wasted repeats."

title.zh-TW: 一次過關率獨立成報表第三區，頂部 KPI 卡不再重複顯示
title.en: One-pass rate becomes an independent third section in the report, removing duplicates from top KPI cards

body.zh-TW: 你想知道哪款模型最省心、最不需要你回頭反覆插手修正，「一次過關率」現在被拉升成報表第三區的獨立大板塊。這項衡量 AI 能否一次搞定任務的指標早就算好，先前卻埋在第 11 區「使用習慣」的小卡裡，多數人根本捲不到。如今它改排在洞察之後、工具之前，各模型採用排行列版面依過關率由高至低排序，直接回答哪款模型最不用重修，而非單看誰的對話輪次多。頂部關鍵績效指標（KPI，衡量核心表現的量化卡片）也同步移除了重複的一次過關率，解決過去五張卡硬塞在雙欄網格中的難看排版，而且沒有新增任何多國語系文字鍵。⟦這就像餐廳評鑑把「廚師一試成菜率」從附錄角落拉到首頁專欄，依退菜次數由少到多排列，頂部總覽區便無須再塞入重複的概括數字。⟧
body.en: For those wanting to know which model requires the least intervention and fewest follow-up fixes, "one-pass rate" has been promoted to a standalone third section in the report. This metric measuring whether AI completes tasks on the first attempt was already computed, but previously sat buried inside a small card under section 11 "usage habits" where most users never scrolled. It is now positioned after Insights and before Tools, with model rows using a ranked layout sorted by pass rate from highest to lowest to directly answer which model needs the fewest revisions rather than just looking at turn count. The top key performance indicator (KPI) cards also removed the duplicate one-pass rate, fixing an awkward layout where five cards were squeezed into a two-column grid without requiring any new i18n localization keys. ⟦This is like a restaurant guide moving the "chef first-try dish success rate" from an appendix corner to a front-page column sorted from fewest dishes sent back to most, eliminating the need to crowd redundant overview numbers into the header.⟧

items.original:
**"One-pass rate" is now a section of its own, third from the top.** Whether the AI finished without you stepping in is a measure with no pre-LLM equivalent; the data was already computed and already drawn, but it sat in a small card inside "usage habits" in section 11, where most people never scrolled. It is now a full section placed after Insights and before Tools, and the model rows use the report's existing rank-line layout sorted by pass rate rather than by turns — the question the section answers is which model needs the least going back over, not which one is used most. No new i18n keys were required.
**The top KPI row no longer repeats the one-pass rate.** Five cards laid out badly in a two-column grid, and the full section below already carries the per-model detail.

title.zh-TW: AI 圓桌納入 Codex 的 Astra 預設模型，名單不再寫死
title.en: AI roundtable incorporates Codex's default Astra model as the allowlist is no longer hardcoded

body.zh-TW: 召開 AI 圓桌讓多款模型共同商討問題時，你現在已能指派 Codex 最新的 Astra 模型加入對話。⟦這如同會議室名單原本寫死只邀三位資深代表，當新任首席代表上任時便被警衛攔在門外；把名冊放寬後，新代表就能直接入席開會。⟧`gpt-6-astra` 是 Codex 當前的新預設模型，但圓桌先前的模型白名單寫死了 5.6 版的三款舊變體，導致新旗艦無法登場。這次放行無須更動價目表與報表：LiteLLM 的價格表早已完整收錄該模型的四項實價，報表的顏色分配也只要命中 `gpt` 前綴就能自動對應，切換選擇毫無阻礙。
body.en: When convening an AI roundtable to deliberate issues across multiple models, you can now assign Codex's latest Astra model to the discussion. ⟦This is like a conference room roster that rigidly invited only three senior delegates, causing security to turn away the newly appointed chief delegate at the door until the list was opened up so the new representative could take a seat.⟧ `gpt-6-astra` is Codex's current new default model, but the roundtable's previous model allowlist hardcoded three older 5.6 variants, preventing the new flagship from appearing. Enabling it required no changes to pricing tables or reports: LiteLLM's price list already covers the model's four actual prices, and report color assignments match automatically on the `gpt` prefix, so switching works without another change.

items.original: **The AI roundtable can pick Codex's Astra model.** `gpt-6-astra` is Codex's new default, but the roundtable's model allowlist hard-coded the three 5.6 variants. Pricing and the report needed no change: LiteLLM's table already carries real prices in all four of its fields, and the report's color assignment matches on the `gpt` prefix.

title.zh-TW: 「燒掉成本」更名為「API 等值」，移除新台幣換算並以副標說明差額
title.en: "Cost burned" is renamed to "API equivalent", removing NTD conversion and clarifying gaps via subtitles

body.zh-TW: 每次打開報表看到「燒掉成本」這個標籤，往往讓人誤以為自己真的刷卡付出了這筆費用。這項數值僅是依照官方牌價乘出來的假設數字，對於每個月繳固定月費、邊際成本為零的包月使用者來說相當容易引起誤解。現在五種語言統一改名為「API 等值」，先前繁體中文特有的新台幣換算也一併移除，避免將假設數字再乘上匯率二次失真。該數值本身依然保留，供按量計費的 API 使用者參考。另外，由於「燒掉 Tokens」統計了所有代理工具，而「API 等值」僅能計算具備公開牌價的模型，兩張頭條卡的分母並不相同；因此只有在確實出現無牌價用量時，卡片才會顯示副標題說明兩者的差額。⟦這有如健身房月費會員查看運動手環時，熱量消耗換算出的「外食便當等值金額」僅供參考，若標示成「你今天花掉的餐費」反而會讓人誤以為荷包失血。⟧
body.en: Opening the report and seeing the "Cost burned" label often gave the mistaken impression that one had actually paid that amount out of pocket. Because this figure is merely a hypothetical number multiplied out from official list prices, it easily misled subscription users who pay a fixed monthly fee with zero marginal cost. The label is now unified across all five languages as "API equivalent", and the NTD conversion previously unique to Traditional Chinese has been removed to avoid distorting an assumed number a second time through exchange rates. The value itself remains available for pay-as-you-go API users who need it. Furthermore, because "tokens burned" counts all agents while "API equivalent" can only calculate models with published list prices, the two headline cards do not share the same denominator; a subtitle now explains the gap, but only when unpriced usage actually exists. ⟦This is like a monthly gym member looking at a fitness tracker where burned calories are converted into an "equivalent dining-out cost" for reference, which would falsely imply wasted money if labeled as "money spent on meals today."⟧

items.original: **"Cost burned" is now "API equivalent."** The label presented a figure multiplied out from list prices as money actually spent, which is misleading for subscription users whose marginal cost is zero. Renamed in all five languages; the Traditional Chinese-only NTD conversion went with it, since that ran an assumed figure through an exchange rate a second time. The number itself stays — API users still need it. The two headline cards never shared a denominator: "tokens burned" counts every agent, while "API equivalent" can only count models with a published price, so a subtitle now explains the gap, and only when unpriced tokens actually exist.

title.zh-TW: Token 組成與快取命中改採排行列，微小比例不再被壓扁
title.en: Token composition and cache hit rates switch to ranked lists, preventing tiny shares from collapsing

body.zh-TW: 當單一類別佔比超過九成時，傳統的堆疊長條圖就會變成一場排版災難。先前在快取讀取高達 93.8% 的情況下，其餘三種類別被壓成看不見的細縫，長條內的百分比文字甚至重疊成 `4.6% 0.1.93.7%` 擠在最左側，圖例色塊也缺乏尺寸樣式。輸入、快取寫入與快取讀取都屬於傳入的脈絡，而輸出是生成的文字，性質本不相同。現在改採排行列呈現，四種類別各自擁有獨立的一列與專屬欄位，且長條設有 2% 的最小寬度，讓僅佔 0.7% 的微小產出依然清晰可辨。各工具的快取命中率也套用同款版面依命中率排序，體質最差的工具直接落在最後一列。同時，測試中針對 TypedDict 型別以迴圈變數當鍵遭 mypy 拒絕的問題，也透過 `Any` 中介變數順利修復。⟦這好比大合照時體型差距懸殊、名牌全疊成一團，改成單人單列橫條後，每位成員的身形與名次才清晰可辨。⟧
body.en: When a single category exceeds ninety percent, traditional stacked bar charts turn into a layout disaster. Previously, with cache reads reaching 93.8%, the other three categories collapsed into invisible slivers, in-bar percentage text overlapped into `4.6% 0.1.93.7%` at the far left edge, and legend color swatches lacked sizing styles entirely. Input, cache write, and cache read all represent incoming context while output consists of generated text, making them fundamentally distinct in nature. The presentation has now shifted to ranked lines where each of the four categories receives its own row and dedicated columns, with bars given a 2% minimum width to keep even a tiny 0.7% output clearly visible. Per-tool cache hit rates adopt the same layout sorted by hit rate, placing the worst-performing tool on the final row. Meanwhile, a test issue where mypy rejected loop variables used as keys on TypedDict types was resolved cleanly using an `Any` intermediate variable. ⟦This is like a group photo where huge differences in size cause name tags to pile on top of each other, until switching to individual single-row bars makes every member's stature and standing clear.⟧

items.original:
**Token composition is a ranked list instead of a stacked bar.** With one category at 93.8%, the other three collapsed into invisible slivers, the in-bar percentage labels piled up into `4.6% 0.1.93.7%` at the left edge, and the legend's swatches had no size styling at all. A stacked bar is the wrong chart once a single category passes ninety percent, and the four are not peers anyway — input, cache write and cache read are all context sent in, output is generated. Each category now gets its own row with its own columns, and the bar's 2% minimum width keeps a 0.7% share visible. Per-tool cache hit rates use the same layout, sorted by rate, so the weakest tool is the last row rather than something you have to hunt for.
**A type error in the token composition tests.** `data["summary"]` and the elements of `data["by_agent"]` are TypedDicts, so mypy rejects a loop variable used as a key; the two assertions now go through an `Any` intermediate. The lines came from the composition work and were not caught earlier because that batch had not been pushed yet.

title.zh-TW: 報表資料列改為整列量條，跨區塊數值對齊同一基準線
title.en: Report data rows become full-width bars, aligning values across sections to a shared baseline

body.zh-TW: 檢視報表中不同區塊的數據時，數字與量條不再忽左忽右跳動。⟦這有如試算表裡多張工作表的直欄寬度各吹各的調，數字忽左忽右難以閱讀；重新劃定同一套格線並固定標籤顏色後，整份報表才整齊劃一。⟧過去排版存在四個獨立缺陷：兩套資料列樣式（`.rank-line` 與 `.tool-row`）因欄寬與間距相異，導致數值在各區塊落在不同的水平位置；佔比量條被限制在名稱欄內，只能畫到半列就硬生生中斷；每個區塊層層疊加了區塊、卡片與列框三層多餘邊界；更有兩處區塊缺少欄位表頭。現在資料列改為貫穿整列的進度條，工具區補上了量條元素，且工具的顏色直接綁定代理識別碼（agent id）而非排序位置，避免工具名次互換時發生整批重新塗色的混亂。
body.en: When reviewing data across different report sections, numbers and bars no longer jitter unpredictably between left and right. ⟦This is like a spreadsheet where multiple sheets use mismatched column widths that scatter numbers everywhere, until establishing a unified grid and consistent label colors brings the entire report into clean alignment.⟧ The previous layout suffered from four separate defects: two row styles (`.rank-line` and `.tool-row`) used differing column widths and gaps that placed numbers at different horizontal positions across sections; share bars were trapped inside the name column and abruptly stopped halfway across the row; every section stacked three redundant borders of section, card, and row frames; and two sections lacked column headers entirely. Data rows are now full-width progress bars, the tools section adds bar elements, and tool colors are keyed directly to the agent ID rather than sort position to avoid repainting every tool whenever rankings shift.

items.original: **The report's data rows are filled bars, with columns that line up across every section.** Four separate problems: the two row systems (`.rank-line` and `.tool-row`) used different track widths and gaps, so numbers sat at different x positions in different sections; the share bar was a child of `.name` and capped by the name column, so it drew to about half the row and stopped; every section nested a section frame, a card frame and a row frame; and two sections used the shared layout with no column headers. The tools section had no bar element at all and now has one, with each tool's color keyed on its agent id rather than its sort position — `by_agent` is ordered by tokens, so a palette indexed by position would repaint every tool whenever two swapped places.

title.zh-TW: 報表時間週期與對比標記更明確，移除無刻度的每日折線
title.en: Report timeframes and comparison markers gain clarity, removing scaleless daily line charts

body.zh-TW: 追蹤長期消耗趨勢時，報表展示的時間跨度如今更加清晰嚴謹。每週燃燒趨勢區塊移除了原本夾帶的每日折線圖，因該折線既無刻度也無具體數值，不但對不上「每週」的標題，也無法提供任何可化為行動的有效資訊；底下的週次、數值與週增減橫條則維持不變。同時，報表明確講清楚了比較的基準期間，將「較上月」與「較上週」統合成「較前期」；年度統計區塊也正名為「近 53 週」，其週數由程式常數自動傳入，日後常數調整時文案會即時跟上。⟦這彷彿帳單收據拿掉了沒有刻度與單位的裝飾性波動圖，只保留清楚的每週明細與增減數值，並把對照週期寫得一清二楚。⟧
body.en: When tracking long-term consumption trends, the report's timeframes are now clearer and more rigorous. The weekly burn trend section dropped its embedded daily line chart because it had no scale or values, failed to match the "weekly" heading, and provided no actionable information, while the week numbers, values, and week-over-week bars below remain unchanged. At the same time, the report clarifies its comparison baseline by unifying "vs. last month" and "vs. last week" into "vs. previous period", while the annual section is renamed "last 53 weeks" with the week count passed from program constants so the copy updates automatically if constants change. ⟦This is like a billing receipt stripping away decorative fluctuation charts lacking scales or units, keeping only clear weekly breakdowns with changes and explicitly stating the comparison period.⟧

items.original:
**The weekly burn section lost its daily line chart.** It had no scale and no values, did not match the "weekly" heading it sat under, and could not be read for anything actionable. The rows below it, carrying week number, value and week-over-week change, are unchanged.
**The report says which span it is comparing against.** "vs. last month" and "vs. last week" became a single "vs. previous period," and the annual block is now "last 53 weeks" with the week count supplied by `WrappedReportData.weeks` from `_YEAR_WEEKS`, so the copy follows the constant if it ever changes.

title.zh-TW: 配額警告文案精簡，完整塞入選單列面板不再被截斷
title.en: Quota warning copy streamlined to fit inside menu bar panels without truncation

body.zh-TW: 當你的模型額度即將用盡時，彈出的警告紅字現在能完整顯示於介面之中。先前那行寫死不換行的警語需要 320 到 470 像素寬度，但選單列面板（popover，點擊狀態列圖示展開的小視窗）的文字框僅有 304 至 320 像素，加上卡片外框設定了隱藏溢出內容以維持復古造型，整行紅字因此直接被切斷。實測 13 個面板在 5 種語言下的表現，日文最慘被削掉 81 至 150 像素，英文也只有三個面板能剛好裝下。現在文案在維持原意下全面縮短，左右對決的世界盃面板更提供省略重置時間的超短版本，完美適應每邊僅 151 像素的狹窄空間。⟦這如同行李吊牌框格尺寸固定，原本冗長的手寫警語硬塞進去只會被切掉後半截；換成精簡標語後，整行提示便完整呈現。⟧
body.en: When your model quota is running low, the red warning text now displays fully within the interface. Previously, the hardcoded nowrap warning required 320 to 470 pixels of width, but the menu bar panel text box was only 304 to 320 pixels, and because card frames hid overflowing content to preserve a retro aesthetic, the red line was cut off directly. Across 13 panels in 5 languages, Japanese suffered the most by losing 81 to 150 pixels, and English fit in only three panels. The copy is now universally shortened while preserving its original meaning, and the head-to-head World Cup panel provides an ultra-short variant that omits the reset time, fitting neatly into the narrow 151 pixels on each side. ⟦This is like a fixed-size luggage tag where lengthy handwritten warnings get cut off at the edge, but switching to a concise message displays the full reminder cleanly.⟧

items.original: **The quota warning fits inside the panels.** The red "running out" line was `white-space: nowrap` and needed 320–470px, but the panels' text box is 304–320px and the cards are `overflow: hidden` — deliberate retro chrome, not removable — so the sentence was cut off. Measured across 13 panels × 5 languages: Japanese lost 81–150px, and only three panels' English fit. The wording is now shorter with the same meaning. The World Cup panel gets an even shorter variant that omits the reset time, since its head-to-head layout leaves each side only 151px.

title.zh-TW: 年度帳本不再因版本不合無聲清空，歷史紀錄妥善防護
title.en: Year ledger is no longer silently cleared on version mismatches, safeguarding historical records

body.zh-TW: 累積整整一年的 AI 使用紀錄，往後再也不會因為程式升級而無聲無息被歸零蒸發。⟦這就像圖書館換了新的索書號編碼規則，不能因此把整櫃舊藏書當垃圾直接倒掉，而應先照常上架供人借閱，只有真正碎成紙屑的殘卷才移至隔離室留存。⟧年度帳本模組原本有四條路徑會直接回傳空帳本，其中最嚴重的便是資料規格版本不符；過去只要開發者微調欄位並調升版號，全球使用者累積的歷史便會靜靜歸零，且毫無備份可救。開發時實測更發現，一次升版就讓本機熱力圖從 119 天驟降至 36 天。現在版本不符時只會記錄警告，依舊逐日解析舊資料；只有在檔案完全無法讀取或結構徹底損毀時，才會先隔離備份至 `~/.usage/quarantine/` 資料夾，周全守護歷史紀錄。
body.en: A full year of accumulated AI usage history will no longer vanish silently to zero due to software upgrades. ⟦This is like a library adopting new call number rules: it shouldn't discard entire shelves of older books as trash, but keep them on shelves for borrowing while reserving quarantine storage only for scrolls shredded beyond recognition.⟧ The year ledger module previously had four execution paths that returned an empty ledger, the most severe being schema version mismatches; whenever developers tweaked fields and bumped the version, users worldwide quietly lost their entire history with no backups to recover from. Testing during development revealed that a single version bump caused the local heatmap to plunge from 119 days to 36. Version mismatches now merely log a warning and continue parsing older data day by day, moving files into the `~/.usage/quarantine/` directory as isolated backups only when they are genuinely unreadable or structurally corrupted to protect historical records.

items.original: **The year ledger is never silently discarded.** `_read_year_ledger()` had four paths that returned an empty ledger, the worst being a `schema_version` mismatch: anyone changing a ledger field and bumping the version would have quietly zeroed every user's accumulated history, with no backup to recover from. This file exists precisely so that history survives after the raw logs rotate away, so clearing it defeats the thing it is for. Measured during development: one version bump took the local heatmap from 119 days to 36. A mismatched version now logs a warning and parses day by day anyway — `_year_day_from_json` already tolerates missing fields — and only a genuinely unreadable or structurally wrong file is moved into `~/.usage/quarantine/` before returning empty, matching what the disk cache already does.

title.zh-TW: 裸倉庫工作樹不再把同專案拆成兩筆，清理後綴並修復歷史
title.en: Bare repo worktrees no longer split one project into two, cleaning suffixes and repairing history

body.zh-TW: 在裸倉庫（沒有工作目錄的 Git 主儲存庫）中建立工作樹時，同一專案往後不再被報表拆成兩筆紀錄。先前專案名稱解析器將工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）路徑解回主目錄後直接取尾端名稱，讓專案名多帶了 `.git`。這使純路徑解析的 Claude 回報 `obsidian00`，其餘三組讀取器卻回報 `obsidian00.git`；本機實測達 5997 筆對 3732 筆，報表上同一專案被拆成 21.70% 與 10.80% 兩筆。三層架構已同步修復：解析器會去除結尾的 `.git`，Codex 分片快取升版以重新解析 28 個舊分片，年度帳本則在讀取時將 `.git` 摺疊併回原專案名。⟦這恰似同一家分公司只因招牌多印了副檔名，就被會計帳冊當成兩家企業分開記帳；統一歸併後數據才合而為一。⟧
body.en: When creating a worktree from a bare repository, the same project will no longer be split into two separate entries in reports. Previously, the project name resolver resolved worktree paths back to the main directory and took the basename directly, leaving the project name with an unwanted `.git` suffix. This caused path-only Claude to report `obsidian00` while the other three loaders reported `obsidian00.git`; locally, this amounted to 5997 entries against 3732, splitting the same project in the report into 21.70% and 10.80%. All three architectural layers have been fixed: the resolver strips the trailing `.git`, the Codex shard cache was bumped to re-parse 28 old shards, and the year ledger folds `.git` back into the base project name at read time. ⟦This is just like a branch office being logged as two separate businesses in accounting ledgers simply because its sign had a file extension printed on it, until unified consolidation merges the figures back together.⟧

items.original: **A git worktree whose main repo is bare no longer splits one project into two.** `resolve_project_name()` resolved the worktree back to its main path and took the basename, so the project name carried a `.git` suffix. `adapters/claude.py` parses paths without calling git and reported `obsidian00`, while the other three loaders went through `project_resolver` and reported `obsidian00.git`; locally that was 5997 entries against 3732, and the report listed one project twice, at 21.70% and 10.80%. The same bug sat in three layers: the resolver now strips a trailing `.git`, Codex's shard cache went from schema 4 to 5 so the 28 shards holding the old name are re-parsed, and the year ledger — which cannot be invalidated by a version bump without losing the only copy of that history — folds `X.git` back into `X` at read time instead.

title.zh-TW: Token 單位進位不再跳級錯誤，四捨五入後自動重新校準
title.en: Token units no longer miscalculate tiers on round-up, recalibrating automatically after rounding

body.zh-TW: 當你的 token 消耗量剛好接近單位級距的邊緣時，報表上的數字與單位現在會正確跳級。⟦這就像電子磅秤在物體達九百九十九點九五公克時進位，數值跨入整數，單位標籤卻沒跟著切換而秀出「一千點零克」；重新校準級距後，便會準確切換成一公斤。⟧函式 `_fmt_tokens` 過去在格式化 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）數值時，先根據未縮放的原始值決定單位級距，完成縮放並執行四捨五入後，卻沒有再次檢查數字是否已經滿額進位。這導致 999,950 遭到四捨五入後被印成古怪的 `1000.0K`，而 999,950,000 也被印成 `1000.0M`。現在進位後會重新審查級距，確保單位如實躍升。
body.en: When your token consumption nears the boundary of a unit tier, numbers and units on reports will now advance correctly. ⟦This is like a digital scale rounding up at 999.95 grams into a whole number but failing to switch unit labels and showing "1000.0 grams", until recalibrating the tier correctly flips the display to one kilogram.⟧ When formatting token values, the `_fmt_tokens` function previously selected unit tiers from unscaled raw values, but failed to re-check whether rounding pushed the number across the tier threshold after scaling. This caused 999,950 to be printed as an awkward `1000.0K` after rounding, and 999,950,000 as `1000.0M`. Unit tiers are now re-evaluated after rounding to ensure units advance properly.

items.original: **Token units no longer skip a tier when they round up.** `_fmt_tokens` picked the tier from the raw value and rounded afterwards without re-checking, so 999,950 printed as `1000.0K` and 999,950,000 as `1000.0M`.

title.zh-TW: Antigravity 用量能顯示在互動儀表板了，表格名稱不再只留小寫代號
title.en: Antigravity usage now appears in the interactive dashboard, and table headers no longer stay as raw lowercase IDs

body.zh-TW: 你在 `usage` 查詢用量時，若裝有 Antigravity，過去切到互動儀表板只會看到 `No data` 的空白分頁。⟦這就像停車場管理處明明有登錄，出口繳費機卻自備名冊且漏記新車號，讓車主在螢幕上只查到「查無資料」，欄位也只印出底盤代號。⟧問題在於儀表板與 `usage report` 各自維護代理到載入器的對照表，先前只有報表納入 `antigravity`，即便報表指令能載入用量，偵測到安裝的儀表板分頁依然只渲染出 `No data`；終端機表格也缺少 Antigravity 的簡稱與顯示名稱，欄位標題只能留著原始小寫代理 ID。兩份對照表過去缺乏一致性檢查，最初的迴歸測試（防範舊功能被改壞的自動驗證）甚至直接寫死三款已知代理而未比對雙方清單，無法維持鍵值同步；現在測試已強制要求兩邊鍵值完全相等。
body.en: When checking usage with `usage`, if Antigravity was installed, switching to the interactive dashboard previously only showed a blank tab with `No data`. ⟦This is like a parking office having a vehicle registered, but the exit payment machine keeps its own roster and misses the new plate number, leaving the driver seeing "No data" on screen while fields only print raw chassis codes.⟧ The problem was that the dashboard and `usage report` each maintained separate agent-to-loader mapping tables. Previously, only the report included `antigravity`, so even though the report command could load usage, the dashboard tab for a detected installation still rendered `No data`. Terminal tables also lacked Antigravity's short and display names, leaving column headers stuck with the raw lowercase agent ID. The two mapping tables previously lacked consistency checks, and the initial regression tests (automated checks preventing existing features from breaking) even hard-coded three known agents instead of comparing both lists, failing to keep keys synchronized; tests now enforce exact key equality across both sides.

items.original: **Antigravity usage now appears in the interactive dashboard with consistent labels.** The dashboard and `usage report` maintain separate agent-to-loader maps, and only the report map included `antigravity`, so a detected Antigravity installation opened a dashboard tab that rendered `No data` even though the report command could load its usage. The terminal tables also lacked Antigravity's short and display names, leaving their headings as the raw lowercase agent ID. The maps had no parity check, and the first regression test hard-coded the three known agents instead of comparing the two maps, so it could not keep their keys synchronized; it now asserts exact key equality. Reported and fixed by @ClarenceKuo in #126.

title.zh-TW: macOS 應用程式套件的文字介面又能開了，字寬表完整打包不閃退
title.en: The TUI launches from the macOS app bundle again, packing complete character width tables without crashing

body.zh-TW:
從 macOS 應用程式套件啟動終端文字介面時，畫面不再因缺漏字寬資料而當場閃退。⟦出門施工若只帶工具本體，漏掉夾層裡的零件，到現場就無法開工；整箱連同配件帶齊才不缺件。⟧打包工具 py2app 原本把 `rich` 列在 `includes`，只收集靜態引用掃得到的檔案。但 `rich/_unicode_data/__init__.py` 是在繪圖當下以 `import_module()` 動態載入各版本 Unicode 字寬表，導致打包出的 app 僅帶了 `__init__` 與 `_versions`，一畫第一張表格就當場崩潰：
```
usage --tui  # 拋出 ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rich._unicode_data.unicode17-0-0'
```
不經過 `rich` 渲染的選單列模式不受影響。現在 `rich` 改列在 `packages`，整包目錄直接複製而非只收掃得到的片段，文字介面（TUI，終端文字操作畫面）恢復正常。
body.en:
When launching the terminal text user interface from the macOS app bundle, the screen no longer crashes on the spot due to missing character width data. ⟦If you head out to a job site carrying only the main tool while leaving the parts in the compartment behind, you cannot start work once you arrive; bringing the whole case along with all accessories ensures nothing is missing.⟧ The packaging tool py2app previously listed `rich` under `includes`, collecting only files reachable by static import scans. However, `rich/_unicode_data/__init__.py` dynamically loads per-version Unicode width tables via `import_module()` at render time, causing the packaged app to carry only `__init__` and `_versions` and crash immediately upon drawing the first table:
```
usage --tui  # throws ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rich._unicode_data.unicode17-0-0'
```
Menu bar mode, which does not render through `rich`, is unaffected. `rich` is now listed under `packages` so the entire directory is copied directly rather than only scanned fragments, restoring the text user interface (TUI) to normal.

items.original: **The TUI launches from the app bundle again.** `rich` was listed in py2app's `includes`, which collects only what its static import graph can see — but `rich/_unicode_data/__init__.py` loads its per-version Unicode width tables through `import_module()` at render time, so the bundle shipped that package carrying `__init__` and `_versions` alone and `usage --tui` died with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'rich._unicode_data.unicode17-0-0'` on the first table it drew. Menu bar mode, which never renders through `rich`, was unaffected. `rich` is now a `packages` entry, which copies the whole tree instead of the reachable parts of it. Reported by @dvakatsiienko in #125.

title.zh-TW: Fable 5.1 補上離線備援價格，對帳腳本不再整族跳過
title.en: Fable 5.1 gains offline fallback pricing, and the audit script no longer skips the entire family

body.zh-TW: Claude Code 2.1.257 起將 Fable 5.1（`claude-fable-5-1`）設為預設，離線計價缺口如今補齊。先前寫死的備援價目表只有 `claude-fable-5`，每當下載價目表缺失或過期，Fable 5.1 的每個 token（AI 計費單位）都被算成 $0。它的快取重讀價是 `0.25e-6`，只有 Fable 5 的四分之一，沿用舊資料也不正確。此缺口過去未被察覺，因 `scripts/check_fallback_pricing.py` 只比對 `opus|sonnet|haiku`，不論新舊皆跳過 Fable 家族。現在 Fable 5.1 已補上離線價格，對帳腳本也納入稽核。⟦保險費率表漏記新車的備援費率，斷線時計價直接歸零，查帳員還只抽查舊車；現在費率與稽核皆已補齊。⟧
body.en: Claude Code 2.1.257 set Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`) as the default, and the offline pricing gap is now filled. The hard-coded fallback price table previously only contained `claude-fable-5`, so whenever the downloaded price table was missing or expired, every Fable 5.1 token was costed at $0. Its cache-read price is `0.25e-6`, only a quarter of Fable 5's, so inheriting older data would also be incorrect. This gap went unnoticed in the past because `scripts/check_fallback_pricing.py` only matched `opus|sonnet|haiku`, skipping the Fable family regardless of whether models were old or new. Now Fable 5.1 has its offline price added, and the audit script includes it in checks. ⟦An insurance rate sheet missed fallback rates for new car models, resetting pricing to zero during outages while auditors only sampled old cars; now both the rates and audit coverage are complete.⟧

items.original: **Fable 5.1 has an offline price, and the fallback table's own audit no longer skips the entire Fable family.** Claude Code 2.1.257 made Fable 5.1 (`claude-fable-5-1`) the default of the Fable line, but the hard-coded fallback table only carried `claude-fable-5`, so whenever the downloaded price table was missing or stale every Fable 5.1 token was costed at $0. Its cache-read price is `0.25e-6` — a quarter of Fable 5's — so inheriting the older entry would not have been correct either. The gap went unreported because `scripts/check_fallback_pricing.py` matched only `opus|sonnet|haiku`: no `fable` model, old or new, was ever in scope for the audit that exists to catch exactly this.

title.zh-TW: 帶日期模型不再退回新版價格，補齊五款服役中模型
title.en: Dated models no longer fall back to newer version pricing, adding five active models

body.zh-TW:
查詢帶日期的舊模型離線價格時，程式不再誤退回到較新版本的便宜價格。⟦公車站牌若只看開頭數字，想搭四號公車的乘客會被載上四之六號新線；現在完整對齊路線才放行。⟧先前 `_resolve_model_key` 只要鍵名以查詢字串加連字號開頭就算命中。這讓 `claude-opus-4-20250514` 被解析成 `claude-opus-4-6`，離線時每百萬 token（AI 計費單位）算 $5 而非真實的 $15，只有真實費用的三分之一。現在查詢自帶版本號時，不再接受追加尾數的候選；無版本號的泛稱如 `claude-sonnet` 照舊解析得到，同等具體程度取較新版本，具名變體（gpt-5 到 gpt-5-pro）不受影響。表裡原本缺失但仍在服務的五個模型一併補上，並剝除 Bedrock 版本後綴讓查詢正確計價：
```
claude-opus-4
claude-opus-4-1
claude-opus-4-5
claude-sonnet-4
claude-sonnet-4-5
claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0  # 剝除 Bedrock 後綴（v1:0）後正確計價
```
body.en:
When querying offline prices for older dated models, the program no longer mistakenly falls back to the cheaper price of a newer version. ⟦If a bus stop sign only looks at the leading digit, passengers looking for Bus 4 would be carried onto the newer 4-6 line; now the full route must match before letting them board.⟧ Previously, `_resolve_model_key` counted any key starting with the query string followed by a hyphen as a hit. This caused `claude-opus-4-20250514` to resolve to `claude-opus-4-6`, costing $5 per million tokens offline instead of the actual $15—only one-third of the real cost. When a query carries its own version number, candidates with an appended trailing digit are no longer accepted. Generic names without version numbers like `claude-sonnet` still resolve as before, picking the newer version among equally specific keys, while named variants (`gpt-5` to `gpt-5-pro`) remain unaffected. Five models still in service that were previously missing from the table have been added, and Bedrock version suffixes are stripped so queries price correctly:
```
claude-opus-4
claude-opus-4-1
claude-opus-4-5
claude-sonnet-4
claude-sonnet-4-5
claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0  # prices correctly after stripping Bedrock suffix (v1:0)
```

items.original: **A dated model no longer falls back to a newer version's pricing.** `_resolve_model_key` matched any table key that started with the queried name followed by a hyphen, so `claude-opus-4-20250514` resolved to `claude-opus-4-6` and was costed at $5/M instead of $15/M — a third of the real figure — whenever the offline table was in use. A query that already carries its own version number now rejects a candidate that merely appends another digit, while a version-less name like `claude-sonnet` still resolves, and among equally specific keys the newest version wins. Named variants (`gpt-5` → `gpt-5-pro`) are unaffected. The five models still in service that the table had never carried — `claude-opus-4`, `claude-opus-4-1`, `claude-opus-4-5`, `claude-sonnet-4`, `claude-sonnet-4-5` — were added, and a Bedrock version suffix is now stripped so `claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0` prices correctly.

title.zh-TW: 備援價目表對帳改採解析比對，消除誤報與常態錯誤結束代碼
title.en: Fallback pricing audit switches to resolution matching, eliminating false positives and persistent error exit codes

body.zh-TW: 檢查備援價目表的對帳腳本現在只回報解析失敗的模型，不再給出一份無人能處理的混亂清單。先前 `compare_pricing` 兩個方向都用字面鍵名相減，但備援價目表本就刻意不帶日期後綴。這讓明明算得出價格的模型（例如 `claude-haiku-4-5` 與 `claude-opus-4-7-20260416`）都被報成缺漏。回報的 12 筆缺口有 3 筆是假的，腳本的結束代碼也因此長期為 1，真的缺口混在雜訊裡看不出來。現在兩個方向都改用 `_resolve_model_key` 判斷。⟦門禁警報若死板比對整串卡號，刻意省略換證日期的合格卡全被誤報成黑名單，警示燈常亮反而掩蓋了真正的闖入者；改採對照解析後才恢復平靜。⟧
body.en: The audit script checking fallback pricing tables now only reports models that actually fail to resolve, rather than outputting a confusing list that no one could act on. Previously, `compare_pricing` diffed raw literal keys in both directions, even though the fallback table deliberately omits date suffixes. This caused models that could calculate prices perfectly well (such as `claude-haiku-4-5` and `claude-opus-4-7-20260416`) to be flagged as missing. Three of the 12 reported gaps were false, keeping the script's exit code at 1 persistently and making real gaps indistinguishable from the noise. Both directions now evaluate models through `_resolve_model_key`. ⟦If an access control alarm rigidly compares full card numbers, valid cards deliberately omitting renewal dates get falsely flagged as blacklisted, and a constantly lit warning light ends up masking real intruders; switching to lookup resolution restores calm.⟧

items.original: **The fallback pricing audit reports what actually fails to resolve, instead of a list nobody could act on.** Both directions of `compare_pricing` diffed raw dictionary keys, but the fallback table drops date suffixes on purpose — so models that price perfectly well, such as `claude-haiku-4-5` and `claude-opus-4-7-20260416`, were reported as missing. Three of the twelve reported gaps were false, the script's exit code had been 1 for as long as that was true, and a real gap was indistinguishable from the noise. Both directions now resolve through `_resolve_model_key`.

title.zh-TW: 用量表格顯示 Opus 5 與 Fable 5.1 簡稱，不再只印原始代號
title.en: Usage table displays short names for Opus 5 and Fable 5.1 instead of raw model IDs

body.zh-TW: 打開終端機檢視用量表格時，畫面本該為各個模型顯示簡短易讀的名稱，方便一眼掌握用量分佈。但先前簡稱字典 `MODEL_SHORT` 裡缺少了 Opus 5 與 Fable 5.1 這兩款新條目，導致表格在列出用量時，只能直接印出長串的原始模型代號（raw model IDs），讓整行排版顯得雜亂又難以閱讀。現在用量表格已補齊這兩款模型的對照設定，會正確顯示簡短名稱。⟦手機通訊錄若漏填好友姓名，來電時螢幕只能秀出一長串電話號碼；補上暱稱後，一眼就能認出是誰撥來。⟧
body.en: When opening the terminal to view usage tables, the screen should display short, readable names for each model to help grasp usage distribution at a glance. However, the short-name dictionary `MODEL_SHORT` previously lacked entries for Opus 5 and Fable 5.1, forcing the table to print long raw model IDs and making the layout cluttered and difficult to read. The usage table now includes mapping entries for both models, displaying clean short names properly. ⟦If a phone contact list misses a friend's name, incoming calls only show a long phone number on the screen; once the nickname is added, you can recognize who is calling at a glance.⟧

items.original: **The usage table shows a name for Opus 5 and Fable 5.1.** `MODEL_SHORT` had no entry for either, so both were printed as their raw model IDs.

title.zh-TW: 配額提醒提早至用掉一半即發送，單次讀數最多一則通知
title.en: Quota warnings fire earlier at 50% usage, sending at most one notification per reading

body.zh-TW: 你的配額通知現在會提早跳出提醒，且單次讀數絕不連續送出兩則重複通知。Codex 0.153.0 起，五小時視窗剩不到一半就會提醒 Plus 與 Team 使用者。但 `usage` 先前等到 90% 才提醒，等於被監控的工具比監控端還早出聲。預設門檻在 macOS 與 Windows 一致改為 `[50.0, 90.0]`，仍可透過 `quota_notification_thresholds` 自行調整。單次讀數可能一口氣跨過兩個門檻，例如 app 在配額已達 95% 時才啟動，或用量單次大跳；這時只有跨過的最高門檻會發送通知，其餘標記為已通知並鎖定，一次觀測絕不冒出兩則重複提醒。⟦河川警戒在水位達一半與九成時各廣播一次，若暴雨讓水位瞬間破九成，警報只響最緊急的紅燈，不重複播送低階警訊。⟧
body.en: Your quota alerts now trigger earlier, and a single reading never sends two consecutive duplicate notifications. Starting with Codex 0.153.0, Plus and Team users are warned once less than half of the five-hour window remains. However, `usage` previously waited until 90% before alerting, meaning the monitored tool warned earlier than the monitor itself.
